It actually trained me to be more successful for FFVI, which made this an important entry for me.

[LunaticSlave] At lvl 29, got it on 1st try. Was just like any other battle as long you keep defending Reuben, when MC got below 50% hp i used Life on him for full hp.

Boss will start using petrify on last phase, when he has only one head straight up. Got petrified like 3 times but was manageable, he will never petrify both at same time, you will have time to use a heal potion to cure it.

[Delrelm] Had the misfortune of MC getting confused and using Fire when I was almost at the boss so I had to leave Lava Dome and re-do it so I could unlock this achievement

[LordCatII] I got this at level 23/24, you don't really need to grind. A lot of people have already said it, but try using all your magic before entering so you don't use any while confused. An easy way of doing this is taking the teleport back to the Ice Cave and use your black and wizard magic in there, white magic you can spam out of combat to remove it all. Also in case you weren't aware, Life is a full heal, whether you're dead or not. You can use it on an alive party member at should if they are low enough, just in case. While traversing don't fight every enemy, just the ones you think you need to. Keep an eye on what enemies Reuben can one shot and have him focus those to reduce the amount of attacks coming your way while your character focuses the ones it takes Reuben two hits to kill. Make absolutely sure you get the Moon Helm before challenging the boss. For the boss itself, Reuben is almost always dealing less damage, so it is well worth it to have him always defend Reuben to halve the damage coming your way. Always use Life when your character would die to a Fire Breath to make sure you can defend and use a heal potion as soon as someone gets petrified. Phase 2 keep defending unless Reuben is at full health. Scrunch seems to crit so often and if he isn't at full health he can't tank the crit. However the boss only does single target damage, so heal after Reuben gets hit. Take your time, play smart and you can get this easily!

[patastrophic] This was rough but very doable at level 23.  I followed the advice from earlier in the comments, I think originally by Mortinho but it was Rine's comment that I read.  Sorry if I'm misattributing credit.

- Have your MC defend Reuben every turn.
- Have Reuben attack as long as you are safe from a OHKO.
- Have Reuben cast Life on MC if MC dies, or if you think you'll get 1-shot this turn.
- If Reuben got poisoned, I had him use a Heal on himself to be safe.  Not sure if necessary.
- Fun fact: If you cast Life on a live party member, it's just a full heal.  I discovered it by accident in this fight.  It's way more efficient for Reuben to heal himself with it than spamming Cure potions if he gets low.

I fought the Hydra at lvl 23, and after all 32 treasure chests I was down to 30 potions. But most fights were on auto ally with speedup, so not exactly efficient. With manual combat 50 potions are probably an overkill.

RetroAchievements achievement guide: Final Fantasy: Mystic Quest
Source: https://github.com/RetroAchievements/guides/wiki/Final-Fantasy:-Mystic-Quest

# Synopsis
|   |   |
|:--|:--|
|Set Difficulty|5/10|
|Approximate time to master|15-20 Hours|
|Minimum numbers of playthroughs needed|1-2|
|Number of missable achievements|8|
|Does difficulty affect achievements?|Not applicable|
|Hardest achievement of the set|Illiterate [achievement 449400] (25 points)|
|Set Developers|UNHChabo (https://retroachievements.org/user/UNHchabo) suspect15 (https://retroachievements.org/user/suspect15)

# Introduction
Final Fantasy: Mystic Quest is a role-playing video game developed and published by Square for the SNES. Originally released in North America in 1992, Final Fantasy: Mystic Quest was meant to serve as "Entry-Level Role Playing Adventure" and is heavily simplified compared to it's predecessors. Such simplifications includes a reduced two character party system, the ability to have the 2nd character act automatically, and the ability to save anywhere and retry battles.

The game itself focuses on a young man named Benjamin who meets a mysterious old man as his home is destroyed by an earthquake. He must then fulfill his destiny by traveling the world to collect the four crystals and bring light back to the world. Along the way he will meet a variety of allies who will help him on his quest.

# General Tips

 - Brown chests reset and can be looted again by exiting and re-entering an area. This allows you to always keep a full stock of healing items on hand. Worth noting is that all optional chest achievements must be completed without leaving the area.
 - Monsters also respawn upon exiting and re-entering and can be use to grind levels if needed.
 - Red Chests contain equipment upgrades and spells. Be sure to save before opening if going for the Illiterate [achievement 449400] achievement and not referencing a guide.
 - In general, it's worth picking up all equipment upgrades as you progress as they provide not only a boost to your stats but protection against status ailments.
 - The "Defend" command causes the party member defending to take the attacks directed at the character they are covering. This can be useful to protect you ally on a turn they are setting up to heal to avoid wiping. 
 - Life magic both revives a party member but also provides a full heal regardless of status. This is generally the better choice for single target healing.
 - Weapons also have overworld interactions depending on the one equipped. Swords can be used to hit swtiches, axes can cut trees, claws can be used to climb some walls, and bombs can be used to destroy breakable walls.
 - Only Benjamin will gain experience throughout the quest and allies will join and remain at fixed levels. It's still usually worth progressing to find your next ally if you don't have one before clearing optional battlefields.

# Illiterate Achievement

Illiterate (25) [achievement 449400]
_Defeat the Dark King without having learned any spells. **(Missable)**_

Of all the missable achievements this is the only one that spans the entire game and limits your abilities within the game. Magic in Final Fantasy: Mystic Quest is extremely strong and trivializes most of the fights (assuming you keep an adequate supply of seeds on hand). Playing without magic provides an additional challenge and changes the strategy needed for some fights. In particular you will be relying more heavily on the "Defend" command as you are reliant on your allies to heal in battle with their magic supply. 

This achievement also interferes with The Bright Side (10) [achievement 449365] which is also missable as you get locked out of the Heal Spell after obtaining the second crystal. You can either do two playthroughs (1 100% and 1 without magic) or you can make an extra save before getting the Heal Spell and revert back once you have all the white magic obtained.

# Walkthrough (Progression/Missables)

The following sections will a rough guide to the game including where to go next and will contain some spoilers. Available rewards and missable achievements will be listed at the top of each section for easy review. 

## Part 1 - The Crystal of Earth
Available Equipment:
* Steel Sword - Starting equipment
* Axe - Given by Kaeli upon clearing Alive Forest
* Bomb - Given by Tristam in the Bone Dungeon
* Steel Armor - Starting equipment
* Steel Shield **(Missable)** - Found in a chest in Bone Dungeon B1 (Can no longer be obtained after getting Jumbo Bombs in the next section)
* Charm - Obtained from a Battlefield west of the Sand Temple

Available Spells:
* Cure - Found in a chest in Foresta
* Quake - Found in a chest in Bone Dungeon B2
* Fire - Found in a chest in Focus Tower 2F

Missable Achievements: No Grinding Allowed (10) [achievement 8133], Bone Collector (10) [achievement 449394]

### Hill of Destiny
You start your adventure on the Hill of Destiny. This area is linear and just consists of some exposition and a boss fight against a Behemoth. Not much to do here besides attack until it's dead and move on.

### Level Forest
Again not much to do since you don't have an axe to clear the trees. Read the story and keep moving.

### Foresta
Here you'll meet your first ally, Kaeli. She comes equipped with the axe we need to progress through the forest as well as Life magic. The Cure magic is available in one of the houses if you so choose.

She Talks to Trees... Then Cuts Them Down (2) [achievement 7531]
_Be joined by Kaeli._

### Level Forest
Progress through the forest and defeat the Minotaur at the end (Try the Life spell). Avoid extra encounters to avoid over-leveling if you are going for No Grinding Allowed (10) [achievement 8133]. Upon finishing the fight, Kaeli will leave the party and gift you her axe. You can now cut down trees. It may be worth returning to Foresta at this time and farming some cure potions for the next dungeon.

### Sand Temple
Just some more plot. You will be joined by Tristam at this point as well. He is equipped with bombs and has access to Life magic.
 

But Isolde is Nowhere to be Found (3) [achievement 7534]
_Be joined by Tristam._

### Battlefield
The Battlefield west of the Sand Temple provides you with the Charm equipment which provides a small defense boost. Skip this and return later if you are going for No Grinding Allowed (10) [achievement 8133]

Battlefield Tourist (3) [achievement 7512]
_Clear out a battlefield._

### Bone Dungeon
Your first major dungeon and home of the Crystal of Earth. This dungeon is relatively straight forward. Half way through you will be given access to bombs from Tristam. As in the prior areas, avoid extra encounters if you are going for No Grinding Allowed (10) [achievement 8133]. 

Collecting all chests inside the Bone Dungeon will grant the following acheivement. Make sure you pick up the Steel Armor on your first run through as well as it becomes missable once you get the next level of bombs. There is the Quake spell in one of the chests so either reset after getting the achievement or make sure you get the armor and come back later for the rest.

Bone Collector (10) [achievement 449394]
_Open all optional treasure chests in the Bone Dungeon. **(Missable)**_

Defeating the boss of the area, Flamerus Rex, will grant you the Sand Coin and the Crystal of Earth restoring life to the region. You will also be given the Elixir to heal Kaili. Beating the boss under level four is required for another missable achievement. This is the only level cap achievement in the set so you are free to grind and clear Battlefields after this. 

But What About the Dragon Claw? (3) [achievement 449394]
_Obtain the Sand Coin._

No Grinding Allowed (10) [achievement 8133]
_Defeat Flamerus Rex before reaching level 5. **(Missable)**_

### Foresta
You're alone again. Return the Elixir to Kaeli and continue on.

### Focus Tower
This tower serves as the main hub that connects all the regions in the game. You will receive coins in your travels that will unlock the doors to new regions (Like the Sand Coin from the Bone Dungeon). The Sand Coin will let you travel up the tower to the next area. During this visit you can collect the Fire Spell from a chest. 

## Part 2 - The Crystal of Water
Available Equipment:
* Knight's Sword - Found in a chest in Ice Pyramid B1
* Cat Claw - Given by Phoebe in the Wintry Cave
* Jumbo Bomb - Given by Phoebe in Falls Basin
* Noble Armor - Found in a chest in Ice Pyramid 4F
* Venus Shield - Found in a chest in Focus Tower 2F
* Steel Helm - Bought in Aquaria
* Magic Ring - Obtained from a Battlefield south of Aquaria

Available Spells:
* Heal **(Missable)** - Found in a chest in Falls Basin (This area becomes unavailable after clearing the Ice Pyramid)
* Exit - Obtained from a Battlefield north of Libra Temple
* Blizzard - Found in a chest in Focus Tower 2F

Missable Achievements: Never Saw It Coming (10) [achievement 449391], The Bright Side (10) [achievement 449365]

### Libra Temple
Here you'll meet your next ally, Phoebe. She comes equipped with the Cat Claw and a larger variety of magic then your previous allies. There is a strange symbol on the floor but you can't currently do anything with it. This would be a good time to clear out the surrounding Battlefields and net yourself the Magic Ring. 

She Predates 'Friends' by Two Years (4) [achievement 7547]
_Be joined by Phoebe._

### Aquaria
The town here is completely frozen over since the disappearance of the Crystal of Water. Here you will be directed to the next dungeon of the game in order to find a crest. You can buy the Steel Helm while you are here.

### Wintry Cave
While progressing through the cave you will fall to the bottom floor and Phoebe will give you the Cat Claw. Claws can be used to climb the textured walls you see throughout dungeons going forward. Upon reaching the end of the dungeon you will find and fight the Squidite and receive the Libra Crest you came here for. These crests can be used to teleport by stepping on a tile with the same symbol. 

Captain Nemo (5) [achievement 8512]
_Defeat the Squidite._

### Libra Temple/Life Temple
Returning to the temple and stepping on the symbol here will now let you teleport to the Life Temple. Here you will some Wakewater to take back to Aquaria. 

If you walk outside of the Life Temple you can get another achievement. 

Hope You're Not Afraid of Heights! (1) [achievement 8514]
_Stand outside the Life Temple._

### Aquaria
Here you will use the Wakewater on the tree in the center of town but it has little effect. 

### Falls Basin
This dungeon consists of a small pillar moving puzzle. It is also home to the Heal Spell and where you will receive the Jumbo Bomb upgrade upon clearing the dungeon. (**Missable: If you haven't gotten the Steel Shield from the Bone Dungeon you will no longer be able to after getting the Jumbo Bombs**)

Beating the boss of Falls Basin will net you the following

An Arctic Specialty (5) [achievement 8586]
_Defeat the Snow Crab._

Fun fact: This area crashes on earlier revisions of the game on certain hardware due to an issue with the music track. As a kid I had to beat this game by saving a resetting the console after every fight.

### Ice Pyramid
The Ice Pyramid serves as the home of the Crystal of Water. You can activate the switches within the statues by using your sword and stabbing them. You'll also note that the enemies in this dungeon are invisible. This is fixed by grabbing the Magic Mirror from a chest. If you are going for all the achievements you'll want to avoid grabbing the Magic Mirror until you've beaten the boss of the dungeon. Make sure you grab the two equipment upgrades on the way to make your time here easier. 

Beating the boss here will grant you the Crystal of Water and the River Coin to continue progressing through the Focus Tower. If you beat the boss without having grabbed the Magic Mirror you will be granted another achievement. **(Missable: Beating the boss here will lock you out of Falls Basin and obtaining the Heal Spell. Make a backup here if you are trying to avoid a full 2nd playthough)**

Let It Flow (5) [achievement 8601]
_Obtain the River Coin._

Never Saw It Coming (10) [achievement 449391]
_Defeat the Ice Golem without the Magic Mirror._

You are now free to collect all the treasures as you are leaving the dungeon as there are no spells obtainable here. 

Narcissus (3) [achievement 8591]
_Obtain the Magic Mirror._

Fridge Raider (10) [achievement 449395]
_Open all optional treasure chests in the Ice Pyramid._

### Aquaria
There world is now no longer covered in ice and snow. Returning to Aquaria you will meet with Spencer and be given the Venus Key.

### Focus Tower
The River Coin you received in the Ice Pyramid will allow you to continue through the tower and into the next region of the game. You can also get both the Venus Shield and the Blizzard Spell during the visit. 

## Part 3 - The Crystal of Fire
Available Equipment:
* Battle Axe - Bought in Fireburg
* Charm Claw - Found in a chest in the Mine
* Mega Grenade - Found in a house in Fireburg
* Moon Helm - Found in  chest in Lava Dome

Available Spells:
* Life - Found in a chest in Lava Dome
* Aero - Found in a chest in Doom Castle B2
* Thunder - Found in Battlefield south of the Mine
* White - Found in a chest in the Volcano

### Fireburg
Here you'll get your last new ally, Reuben. Your goal is to get into the house in the center of town to get the final bomb upgrade, Mega Grenades. To do this you'll need a Multi-Key given by Tristam at the hotel. You can also get the Battle Axe by buying it in one of the houses here. If you listen to the band in hotel here you can also get another achievement. 

Hold the Sauerkraut (5) [achievement 8607]
_Be joined by Reuben._

Rock 'n' Roll (1) [achievement 8607]
_Dance to a rockin' beat._

### Mine
This area contains a lot of one way sections with the conveyors only moving one direction as do the elevators spread throughout. You can find the Charm Claw in a cave near the top of the area. Upon getting to the end and beating the boss, you are able to bomb the boulder trapping Reuben's father and allow access to the later areas. 

Got to Word Your Wish Just Right (5) [achievement 8793]
_Defeat the Jinn._

Fun fact: This area also uses the music track found in Falls Basin and is also prone to freezing on older revisions. 

### Sealed Temple
Assuming you've been clearing Battlefield as you go you should have gotten the Gemini Crest. Using this crest you can get the chests here and unlock another achievement.

Breaking the Seal (1) [achievement 8795]
_Pick up the treasure from the Wintry Temple._

### Volcano
Another dungeon with poor visibility and invisible enemies. This can be remedied by finding the Mask within the dungeon. The White Spell can also be found in a chest here near the entrance.

See Through the Smoke (2) [achievement 8840]
_Obtain the Gas Mask._

Perseus (5) [achievement 8859]
_Defeat Medusa._

### Lava Dome
The Lava Dome is the last dungeon in the region and home to the Crystal of Fire. The missable achievement here requires you to beat the dungeon without using any magic except Reuben's Life Spell. Strongly recommended to enter the area after clearing all the Battlefields you can for experience (worth grinding beyond that) and a full stock of items. Additional seeds can be purchased in Fireburg if needed while the rest can be farmed throughout the world. You'll want to make liberal use of the defense command to keep Reuben alive and utilize Reuben as your main damage dealer/healer. Exiting and re-entering the area will reset this achievement. 

The dungeon is also home to both the Moon Helm as well as Life Magic (this is the final White magic available if your using a second save for that).

The final boss of the area is the Dualhead Hydra. Defeating it will grant you both the Crystal of Fire as well as the Sun Coin needed to progress through the tower some more. 

Praise the Sun (5) [achievement 9054]
_Obtain the Sun Coin._

Speak No Evil (10) [achievement 449392]
_Traverse the Lava Dome and defeat the Hydra without using any magic besides Reuben's Life spell. May not load a save file during attempt._

Like the other large dungeons there is also an achievement for opening all the chests in the area.

Hot Take (10) [achievement 449396]
_Open all optional treasure chests in the Lava Dome._

### Focus Tower
The Sun Coin you received in the Lava Dome will allow you to continue through the tower and into the next region of the game. You can also get the Aero Spell as you are passing through. 

## Part 4 - The Crystal of Wind
Available Equipment:
* Excalibur - Found in a chest in Pazuzu's Tower 4F
* Giant's Axe - Found in a chest in Alive Forest
* Dragon Claw - Given by Tristam in Aquaria
* Apollo Helm - Found in a chest in Mount Gale
* Cupid Locket - Purchased in Windia

Available Spells:
* Meteor - Found in a chest in Giant Tree 2F
* Flare - Found in a chest in Pazuzu's Tower 6F

### Rope Bridge
While crossing the bridge, Reuben will get attacked and fall. Tristam will then join you again.

### Alive Forest
Not much to here on your first visit. You attempt to talk to the big tree and are ignored prompting a return to Aquaria to find someone who can speak with the trees.

### Aquaria
After speaking to a few characters, Kaeli will join you again. Tristam will also give you the Dragon Claw. The Dragon Claw is special in that it can both climb walls and grapple distant hooks to cross gaps. 

### Alive Forest
During this visit you can get the Giant's Axe from on of the chests in the forest. This time Kaeli can talk with the giant tree and he will grant to access to clear out the infestation inside of him. 

### Giant Tree
You will need to progress through this dungeon making liberal use of the Dragon Claw to grapple the branches to cross gaps. You can go back to a lower floor by dropping in holes and will need to do so for progress. Within the dungeon you can find the Meteor Spell within a chest. By beating the boss, Gidrah, the tree with assist you in getting through the rest of the forest to Windia. 

Named for a Kaiju Villain (5) [achievement 9456]
_Defeat Gidrah the chimera._

### Windia
Some more plot here needed to progress. You are asked to assist in rescuing Otto's daughter but in order to do so you must find the source of the wind in the area. During your visit you can buy the Cupid Locket from one of the residents. 

### Mount Gale
Another pretty straight forward dungeon. You can find the Apollo Helm in a chest near the top of the area. Your goal here is to defeat the boss, Dullahan, in order to stop the wind.

Celtic Faerie (5) [achievement 9494]
_Defeat Dullahan._

### Windia 
With the wind stopped, Otto can now build a bridge for you to Pazuzu's Tower.

### Pazuzu's Tower
Pazuzu's Tower is home to the Crystal of Wind and the final coin, the Sky Coin. Upon entering you will find Norma and send her home. 

You'd Better Have Done This First... (2) [achievement 9508]
_Rescue Norma from Pazuzu's Tower._

There is a missable achievement here as well for beating the boss without losing a single battle. The enemies in the tower utilize a lot of status effects that can quickly end a battle in their favor. It is worth collecting all the equipment you can up until this point as well as grinding to make fights easier. Getting to the boss requires trapping them using the switches in the dungeon. You can finish the dungeon up to this point and exit and re-enter to make clearing it without losing easier as the boss will remain stuck on the floor they were on. It is possible to get Pazuzu stuck on the first floor but probably isn't worth the effort so long as you grinding up and have a good supply of items.

In the dungeon you can find Excalibur as well as the Flare Spell

Trapping and defeating Pazuzu will grant you the last crystal and the Sky Coin.

What Goes Up Must Come Down (5) [achievement 9649]
_Obtain the Sky Coin._

Death Unbecomes Us (10) [achievement 449393]
_Traverse Pazuzu's Tower and defeat him without losing a battle._

Like the other large dungeons there is also an achievement for opening all the chests in the area.

Finders Keepers (10) [achievement 449397]
_Open all optional treasure chests in Pazuzu's Tower._

## Part 5 - Saving the World
Available Equipment:
* Gaia's Armor - Found in a chest in Mac's Ship B1
* Aegis Shield - Found in a chest in Focus Tower B2

Available Spells:
* None

### Windia
After some more plot, Reuben will rejoin you. You will now be traveling the world in order to get Mac's Ship which will give you access to Doom Castle.

### Fireburg
Receive the Thunder Rock from Reuben's father

### Windia
Giving the Thunder Rock to Otto will open a bridge back to Spencer's Place

### Spencer's Place
Travel through and grab the Mobius Crest from the chest.

### Kaidge Temple
With the Mobius Crest you can teleport to the Light Temple. Waling outside will give you another achievement. 

Lonely Island (3) [achievement 9655]
_Visit the Light Temple._

### Windia 
Kaeli will give you the Captain's Cap. There is a Mobius Crest tile in the basement of one of the buildings that will teleport you to the Dock and let you enter Mac's Ship

### Mac's Ship
Travel through the ship fighting more enemies. When you get to the front of the ship you will find the Gaia's Armor as well as Captain Mac himself. Talking to him will grant you access to sail his ship to Doom Castle. 

### Windia
Reuben will leave you and be replaced by Phoebe for the remainder of the game. Another good time to go back and clear out any dwelling battlefields and get to max level. You should also have all equipment except for the final shield by now. 

### Focus Tower/Doom Castle
The final dungeon of the game. The dungeon consists of 4 floors that are stylized like the crystal dungeons ending in a fight against a re-skinned (and more powerful) version of the same bosses you beat as you progressed through the game. The Aegis Shield can be found in the area resembling the Bone Dungeon and should be your final piece of equipment.

Beating the bosses will grant you the following

Bleached Bones (5) [achievement 9713]
_Defeat Skullrus Rex._

Much Harder to Melt Stone (5) [achievement 9714]
_Defeat the Stone Golem._

It Only Has Two Legs, So It's Not a Dragon (5) [achievement 9781]
_Defeat the Twinhead Wyvern._

Zuh? (10) [achievement 9782]
_Defeat Zuh._

You will now find yourself on the top floor of the castle faced against the final boss of the game. In the room before you will find chests to max you on all items. Make sure you are in good health before progressing. Upon beating the final boss you will receive your achievement and the credits.

With Guidance from the Crystals (25) [achievement 9793]
_Defeat the Dark King and restore peace to the world._

Assuming you beat the game without collecting any magic of your own you will also unlock the following

Illiterate (25) [achievement 449400]
_Defeat the Dark King without having learned any spells._

Having Benjamin cast Cure on the final boss also grants an achievement

He Found Out (2) [achievement 449399]
_Exploit the Dark King's weakness._

The final dungeon also has one last achievement for getting all the chests. Make sure you have the Aero chest opened already as it is required and leaving to grab it will reset all the optional chests. 

The Black Hand (10) [achievement 449398]
_Exploit the Dark King's weakness._

Assuming you've done all of the above. **Congratulations on beating Final Fantasy: Mystic Quest!!!**

# Miscellaneous Achievements

Well, Now You Can Afford it (4) [achievement 9012]
_Accumulate enough GP to afford an elixir._

Have more then 9000 GP at any given time. Should come naturally while progressing through the mid to late game

Battlefield Expert (5) [achievement 7513]
_Clear all battlefields._

There are 20 Battlefields throughout the game. Recommend completing these as you come across them (with the exception of the ones containing spells) in order to keep Benjamin at an appropriate level.

(                \_______       3. Story        _______/                )
 \    =======            \_____________________/            =======    /
  \___________________________________________________________________/
   ===================================================================

This world is divided into four main regions. In the center of the world,
where they meet, lies Focus Tower. Focus Tower was the connection point,
and was a symbol of unity. The world stayed in a peaceful condition, 
under this way of life, for many years.

One day though, four powerful mosnters stormed Focus Tower. Each stole
one of the coins, that held the key to a section of the world, closing
off the areas from each other. When the monsters left, the world was
in a state of chaos; weaker monsters were appearing in all sections
of the world, and there were many quakes occuring.

Benjamin (aka Hero) lived in a village near the Hill of Destiny. His 
village was destroyed by one of these Quakes, and he fled to the Hill of
Destiny, following a mysteriosu cloaked man. This is where the game 
opens up.

(                \_______      4. Controls      _______/                )
 \    =======            \_____________________/            =======    /

   ===================================================================

Out of Battle
=============

Here is a list of the controls, while you're in an area, but not in
a battle with an enemy:

(A)    - Use weapon + Open Chest + Talk to People
(B)    - Jump
(Y)    - Switch between Auto and Manual companion battle modes.
(X)    - Enter save screen
(L)    - Switch weapon
(R)    - Switch weapon
(Strt) - Pause Menu
(Slct) - Nothing
(Dpad) - Move

In Battle
=========

(A)    - Make Selection
(B)    - Previous Selection
(Y)    - Switch between Auto and Manual companion battle modes.
(X)    - Nothing
(L)    - Switch weapon
(R)    - Switch weapon
(Strt) - Nothing
(Slct) - Nothing
(Dpad) - Change Selections

And here is a brief description of what each option is:

(Battle)  - All battle maneivers are listed here.
            (Attack) - Strike with your selected weapon
            (Item) - Use on of your items.
            (Spell) - Use one of your spells.
            (Defense) - Guard for an enemy's attack.
(Run)     - Attempt to escape the battle.
(Control) - Switch between Auto and Manual companion battle modes.

Map Screen
==========

Here is a list of the controls, while you're on the Map Screen:

(A)    - Enter area
(B)    - Enter Area
(Y)    - Switch between Auto and Manual companion battle modes.
(X)    - Enter Save Screen
(L)    - Switch weapon
(R)    - Switch weapon
(Strt) - Pause Menu
(Slct) - Toggle Scrolling
(Dpad) - Move

As you move from location to location, you'll notice one of two 
things: The area has darknened arrows, or red arrows. If it's red,
you've done what you needed to to open that path, and can move on,
if it's grey, there's still something you haven't done. Additionally,
there are lots of clouds at the beginning. As you exlpore more of
the map, they'll dissapear.

Menu Screen
===========

Here is a list of the controls, while you're on the Pause Menu:

(A)    - Select Option
(B)    - Return to game
(Y)    - Switch between Auto and Manual companion battle modes.
(X)    - Nothing
(L)    - Switch weapon
(R)    - Switch weapon
(Strt) - Nothing
(Slct) - Nothing
(Dpad) - Switch highlighted option

And here is a brief description of what each option is:

(Item) - View/Use items.
(Spell) - View/Use spells.
(Armor) - View armor and their stats
(Weapons) - View Weapons and their stats
(Status) - View charcter stats, EXP, GP, and EXP need to level-up
(Customize) - There are several options here, as shown below:
              (Life Indicate) - Switch between HP bars, or numbers.
              (Control) - Switch between Auto and Manual companion. 
              (Message Speed) - Change speed of messages between 1 & 7.
              (Window Color) - Set the color of pause menu interface.
(Save) - Enter the Save Menu

=====

=======

     He'll come with you, in attempt to get some treasure for himself.
Weapon(s)[First Time]: Ninja Stars
Spell(s)[First Time]: Life
Weapon(s) [Second Time]: Ninja Stars
Spell(s) [Second Time]: Life


Phoebe
======
Bio: Phoebe lives in Aquaria. You'll first meet her in Libra Temple,
     trying to find water to unfreeze her village.
Weapon(s) [First Time]: Cat Claw + Bow of Grace
Spell(s) [First Time]: Life + Cure + Heal + Fire + Thunder
Weapon(s) [Second Time]: Bow of Grace
Spell(s) [Second Time]: Thunder + White + Life + Cure + Heal + Fire 
                        + Blizzard


Reuben
======
Bio: Reuben lives in Fireburg. His father was trapped in a mine, when
     his freind wimped out, and ran away. Reuben and you will team up
     to try and rescue him, before you go for the next crystal.
Weapon(s) [First Time]: Morning Star
Spell(s) [First Time]: Life
Weapon(s) [Second Time]: Morning Star
Spell(s) [Second Time]: Life + White

_____________________
 ________________________/                     \________________________
(                \_______     6. Walkthrough    _______/                )
 \    =======            \_____________________/            =======    /
  \___________________________________________________________________/
   ===================================================================

                          
 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|           Hill of Destiny           |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - None
Boss    - Behemoth
=================

You don't even control most of this level, so it's more of an 
introduction to the game. Hero will follow a cloaked man, to the edge of
a paltform. Press B to jump across, and the first platform will sink
down. 

The cloaked figure will look to Focus Tower in the distance-, and tell
the story of how the Focus Tower connects the four sections of the world
and how monsters have closed them off, and are draining power from the
crystals that guarded each section. As he talks, a monster will appear,
and fight - Behemoth.
                         
               O-------------------------------------O
               |           Behemoth  - 80HP          |
O--------------O-------------------------------------O----------------O
| EXP: 84      | Battle Strategy: This fight isn't hard. You only have|
| GP: 3        | one weapon, and no item or spells though. Keep       |
O--------------O choosing to attack, and he should die. Although, it  |
| Attack List  | is possible to die, if he gets critical hits to much,|
| ===========  | you'll just start the battle over anyway, so don't   |
| Horn         | worry about it. Horn is just a physical attack.      |
O--------------O------------------------------------------------------O 

After you defeat Behemoth, another Quake will start. The cloaked figure
will tell you to meet him in Level Forest. Hero leaves, automatically,
as a quake whipes Hill of Destiny off the map. You only have one 
destination on the map - Level Forest. So, enter the forest.


 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|             Level Forest            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - Tree Wither + Cure Potion(s)
Boss    - None
=================

When you arrive, the cloaked man is waiting for you. Talk to him, and he
wil ltell you to save the Crystal of Earth first, and then leave. This
guy isn't very talkative, is he?

Well, head north, until you see a man in a blue robe. If you talk to him
you'll find out the stone is blocking his path. Jump over him, and push
the stone, and he'l lthank you. He'll also give you a Tree Wither, and
tell you to show it to a girl named Kaeli.

Head left, and you can get 3 potions from the treasure chest. Head all
the way to the right after getting the potion, and you'll leave Level 
Forest, and open the path to Foresta.


 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|                Foresta              |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - Cure [Spell] + Cure Potion(s)
Boss    - None
=================

When you enter Foresta, head into the first tree home on the left. There
are two girls at the table in this house; The one on the left is Kaeli.
Talk to her, and she'll see the Tree Wither, and volunteer to help you.
Kaeli joins your party!

In the back of Kaeli's house, there is a treasure chest with 3 potions
in it. After you get it, leave the house. The house on the right side
of town (the one on the bottom) also has a treasure chest with potions,
if you'd like to get it.

What you really need to pick up in this area, is the white magic spell,
Cure. Head to the north end of the town, and cross the bridge. On the 
right, in the water, are two logs. Jump across them, to the back of a
tree home. There's a door there, so walk into the house, and there will
be a treasure chest with the Cure spell inside. Also, remember, if you
use the bed on the left side of this house, your health will be 
restored. Remember this, as you're fighting monsters later.

After you get the cure spell, exit the house, and leave Foresta. Once 
on the world map, you have to go back to Level Forest. With Kaeli's 
help, you'll be able to go deeper into the forest.


 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|             Level Forest            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Brownie + Slime
Items   - Cure Potion(s) + Heal Potion(s)
Boss    - Minotaur
=================

When you enter the forest with Kaeli in your party, she'll immediately 
cut down a tree with her axe, giving you access to more of the level.
Take out the Brownie that was behind the tree she cut down, and make 
sure to grab thepotion that you got the last time you were here - Chests
that look like this one restore when you leave the level - and you're
good to go.

If you take out the two slimes on the left, you'll clear a path to a
Brownie, who is guarding a chest of potions. Take out the slime on the
right, and you'll be able to advance forward.

There's a glowing tree ahead. Don't approach it until you're at least
level 2 - 2 is fine, 3 would be better - If you take out most of the
enemies in the area, you'll be at level 3, so don't worry. Also, make
sure to heal first, and possibly take out the Brownie and the Slime on
the right, to reach a chest with 3 Heal Potions inside. When you are
ready, approach the tree, and a Minotaur will poison Kaeli. Then, you'll
enter combat!

               O-------------------------------------O
               |           Minotaur - 240HP          |
O--------------O-------------------------------------O----------------O
| EXP: 84      | Battle Strategy: If you have your partner on Manual, |
| GP: 3        | make her attack each turn, unless Hero dies; In which|
O--------------O case, she should use Life to revive him. Use a       |
| Attack List  | similair tactic with Hero. Attack every turn, but use|
| ===========  | Cure if either Kaeli or Hero get low on health. His  |
| Axe          | axe attack is just a physical attack, but his Scream |
| Scream       | ability will do damage, and also lower your defense. |
| Roundhouse   | Also, be prepared for his Roundhouse; It's also a    |
|              | physical attack, but it lays heavier damage. Just    |
|              | keep attacking, and he'll go down, though. If you    |
|              | want to be cheap, use a Life Spell, to bring him     |
|              | down in one hit.                                     |
O--------------O------------------------------------------------------O 

After the battle, Kaeli's mom will come, and take Kaeli home. Hero will
volunteer to get the elixer to save Kaili - He's told it's in the Sand
Temple that's a little north. Kaeli will give Hero her axe - You can 
cut trees down now! - and then, they'll leave.

You can access a Brownie and a chest with a Heal Potion by cutting down
trees on the south-west section of the map. You can also find a chest 
with a Potion inside it, by cutting down trees on the south-east. To
move on though, take the north exit, past where you fought Minotaur.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Battlefield            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Mad Plant + Poison Toad
Reward - 54 EXP
=================

North of Level Forest, right before Sand Temple, is the first
battlefield. Like all future battelfields, it's optional. Fight 10 sets
of monsters, and earn GP and EXP, and sometimes an item. That's how 
things work here! I don't recommend fighting here, until you get Tristam
in your party (you'll get him in Sand Temple).

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Sand Temple            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - None
Boss    - None
=================

This area is real small. Walk through the door in the first room, into
second room, and check the one treasure chest there. You'll find it's
empty. Soon, Tristam will come in, and offer to seel you the elixer for
9000 GP - Of course, you can't afford that! (Even if you do have more
than 9000 GP, he won't sell, despite what people say.)

Hero and Tristam will strike a deal though. Tristam will accompany you
through the Bone Dungeon, and he'll give you the Elixer afterwards. This
is a good deal, isn't it? Well, it's how things are going to turn out.
After Tristam joins the party, exit the sand temple.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Battlefield            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

section: Enemies - Poison Toad + Basilisk + Mad Tree
text:
=================
Enemies - Poison Toad + Basilisk + Mad Tree
Reward - Charm
=================

Before heading to the Bone Dungeon, you really should head left from 
sand Temple, and clear out a battlefield. When you win, you'll pick up
a Charm. The charm is an armor, that will increase your defense, so it's
good to have. When both battlefields you can reach so far, are cleaned 
out, head to the Bone Dungeon. 

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Bone Dungeon           |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Basilisk + Sandworm + Poison Toad + Roc + Skeleton + Gorgon
          + Minotaur Zombie
Items   - Ninja Star(s) + Cure Potion(s) + Seed(s) + Quake [Spell]
           + Sand Coin + Explosive(s)

Boss    - Flamerus Rex
=================

In the beginning of this level, you have a few paths. You can just step
onto the moving sand, to be pushed across the room, which is the easiest
way, or you could choose to fight the monsters on either the left or 
right side, to go around the sand - if you do this, there's a chest with
10 Ninja Stars for Tristam, on both sides. In the other side, open the 
chest at the edge of the sand, to get 3 potions, and then go through the
set of bones that make up a door.

In the next room, jump across the rocks in the water, and go down the 
steps, into the water on the other side. On the left side of the water,
there's another passage of bones. Go through them, and head up the
stairs on the other side. Walk upward, towards the blocked door, and
Tristam will blow it open with a bomb! He'll then offer to sell you 50
bombs for 30GP. Say "Sorry" and he'll cut the price to 15GP, where you
have no choice but to pay - but that's god, you want those bombs!

Before you head to the next room, backtrack a bit. Go into the water,
and through the bones again. Climb up the stairs that are in the
previous room, and walk up, toward the wall. There's aset of bones lying
on the ground. Use a bomb to blow them up. There's a treasure chest
containing a Steel Shield behind them, and it will boost your defense by
5 points! After getting it, continue, and go through the door Tristam
blew open.

The next room is loaded with enemies. You can fight them for the EXP if
you'd like, but there are two main points of interest here. On the north
east part of the room, you can blow apart a blocked door. A Roc, and a
chest of Ninja Stars is behind it. The other, would be stairs to the 
next floor. These are blocked by a Skeleton in the north-west section of
the room.

On the right side of the next room, is a chest full of bombs, blocked by
a Gorgon. If you are out of bombs, which is unlikely, you need to pick
them up. Head north, and there is a single Skeleton, blocking a set of
bones. Defeat the skeleton, and place the bombs, by the two rib bones(?)
that you have access to. The whole set of bones will shatter! If you 
walk all the wya to the right, into the wall, you can enter a hidden
room. Jump across the rocks here, to find a chest with 10 ninja stars
inside it.

On the tight side, out of the mouth of the bones, is a Gorgon, and a 
Skeleton. If you defeat one, or both of them, you can access another
chest with 10 Ninja Stars inside. Afterwards, head to the top of the
screen. You'll find some moving sand pushing east, so you can't cross
over it. Instead, go around the top of it, taking out the Skeleton, and
the Gorgon, bombing the set of bones, when you reach them. After you 
take care of him, head south, using the stairs to reach the next room.

There's a Skeleton blocking the way, as soon as you enter. Kill him, and
move to the left. A Minotaur Zombie is blocking a treasure chest with 10
Ninja Stars in it. After picking up the items, head to the right, to the
Skull coming out of the wall. Bomb its teeth, to open a path. Go
straight, into the next room, where you can pick up 3 seeds. After, turn
around, and come back, through the set of bones. Take a left, about half
way through the bones, and you can enter, to another area of the room.

There's more moving sand, so you'll have to battle the enemies to get
around it - There are 2 Skeletons, and a Minotaur Zombie, that you have
to worry about. On the other side, is another Skull with teeth to bomb.
Head straight, down the bones, and into another room. A chest containing
the Quake spell is here, and you'll want to pick it up! After getting
it, leave the room, and fight the Minotaur Zomie thats on the right of
the set of bones, you'll have one more set of teeth to bomb.

Head into the next room, and make sure to heal, and cure any status 
ailiments, because you're about to fight a boss! Jump over the rock in
the water, and you'll enter battle with Flamerus Rex!

               O-------------------------------------O
               |         Flamerus Rex - 2,200 HP     |
O--------------O-------------------------------------O----------------O
| EXP: 120     | Battle Strategy: There's only one of him, so bombs   |
| GP: 0        | will do a good amount of damage. Have Hero bomb him  |
O--------------O every turn - Or you could use Quake, which is better |
| Attack List  | until you run out of it. Use Tristam's Ninja Stars,  |
| ===========  | using Life if either Tristam, or Hero need healing.  |
| Bone Missile | His Twin Fang and Bone Missle do decent damage on    |
| Rip Earth    | you, but you should be more concerned about Rip Earth|
| Sleep Powder | which does big damage to Hero and Tristam. So don't  |
| Twin Fang    | let both of them get low on HP at the same time. If  |
|              | he uses Sleep Powder, one character will fall asleep,|
|              | so make sure both are able to deal decent damage.    |
|              | Once he falls on the ground, he's about to die. Just |
|              | hurt him a little more. He's immune to poison and    |
|              | parylzing.                                           |
O--------------O------------------------------------------------------O 

After you beat Flamerus Rex, the Sun Crystal will be restored, and 
Tristam will show off a really cool weapon (that you'll get later in the
game.) He'll then give you the elixer, and allow you to check the other
chests, which contain Potions, bombs, and the Sand Coin, the key to a 
door in Focus Tower. Now, backtrack through the dungeon, and leave. 
You'll be doing this alone though, because Tristam takes off, at the
exit of the room you fight Flamerus Rex in. When you are back on the
world map, head back to Foresta. Kaeli still needs the elixer that you
just got.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|                Foresta              |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - Cure Potion(s)
Boss    - None
=================

Enter Kaeli's house, and go into th back room. You'll give Kaeli the 
elixer, and she'll tell you to you that you should visit Aquaria. So,
leav the house, and pick up some potions (they are in the same place as
last time, and now that you have an axe, you can also cut down some 
trees in the south-east part of town to get some more. When your ready,
leave Foresta, and go to Focus Tower.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Battlefield            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Sand Worm + Minotaur Zombie
Reward - 54 GP
=================

To the right of Sand Temple, just before Focus Tower, is another 
battlefield. You should train here, and clean the place out, before you
continue to focus tower. The only prize for clearing it out, is 54 GP,
but the EXP is good, so I reccomend fighting.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Focus Tower            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - Fire [Spell] + Explosive(s)
Boss    - None
=================

When you enter, walk forward, until you see a 1-square gap in the all on
the left. You can walk under that spot, so do so, and then keep walking
upward. You'll meet your friend that cloaked man again, and he'll tell 
you to look for a girl named Phoebe, to join you on your quest, and as
always. He also states "Mac" will play an important role in your quest,
and he leaves without explaining it further.

There are some stairs, walk up them, to reach another floor. Check the
treasure chest, to get some more bombs, and then open the open the door
with the sword on it. Walk through the door, and forward, until you see
more stairs. Go up them, and when you come out from another set of 
stairs, go left, and walk south. You'll see another treasure chest; This
one has the Fire spell in it. After getting the spell, walk north again,
and out the door on the top-most wall.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Battlefield            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Mintmint
Reward - 99 EXP
=================

I don't reccomend fighting in this area, until after you visit Libra
Temple, and you have Phoebe on your team. With two people in your party,
this place will be a source of easy EXP.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Libra Temple           |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - Explosive(s)
Boss    - None
=================

Walk forward, and you'll see a strange crest on the ground. You can't
do anything about that yet. Check the chest to get some bombs, and then
talk to the girl standing behind it. You'll find out that Aquaria has
been frozen! More importantly though, you'll find out that this girl is
Phoebe! When Hero finds this out, he tells her, that he's going with her.
And so, Phebe joins the party! You can leave the Libra Temple, after she
joins.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Battlefield            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Giant Toad + Mintmint
Reward - 300 GP
=================

There is another battlefield to the right of Libra Temple. This one may
be slightly challenging if you have a low level, but the enemies here
will pay some good EXP (for this stage of the game at least.) To top 
that off, you'll also win 300 GP!

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Battlefield            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Giant Toad + Scorpion + Mintmint
Reward - Magic Ring
=================

Yup, two in a row! This one is just right of the other one, and south of
Aquaria. Before you enter this battlefield, make sure Phoebe and/or Hero
have at least a few Black Magics left. You'll be facing a new type of 
enemy here, the Scorpion, and they are weak against Fire. Defeat 10 sets
of enemies, and you'll be rewarded with a Magic Ring; An item that 
raises your defense by 3!

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|                Aquaria              |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - Heal Potion(s) + Refresher(s) + Steel Helm + Cure Potion(s)
Boss    - None
=================

When you arrive in Aquaria, head all the way to the left, and into the 
first house you see. Phoebe will tell you her grandfather, Spencer, is
trapped, and that you need to get Wakewater to melt the ice, and free
him from the tunnel. To get that though, first you'll need the Libra 
Crest, which a monster in Wintry Cave stole.

There is a chest with Heal Potions in the house, and there are some
Refreshers in the house behind it, which you can reach by crossing the
middle platform's bridges. There's also an Inn, where you can rest, to 
restore your health - for 95 GP. It's best to just go back to Foresta,
and heal for free instead. Also, you'll want to pick up a Steel Helm
for 200 GP, in the house in the north-west part of the town. When 
you're ready, leave Aquaria, and you'll be on your way to Wintry Cave.


 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Battlefield            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Scorpion + Edgehog + Giant Toad
Reward - 99 EXP
=================

To the east of Aquaria is yet another Battlefield. This is probably the
first one with some tough battles in it - That is, if you don't have any
Black Magic left. Two out of the three enemies are both weak against 
Fire, so take advantage of that. 

This Battlefield doesn't have the best reward, but it shows you the kind
of enemies you'll be facing in Wintry Cave. If you have any trouble, you
should head back. and train some more, in the Bone Dungeon. Just north
of the Battlefield is Wintry Cave.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Wintry Cave            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

section: Enemies - Scorpion + Edgehog + Landworm + Centaur + Land Turtle + Sparna
text:
=================
Enemies - Scorpion + Edgehog + Landworm + Centaur + Land Turtle + Sparna
          + Giant Toad
Items   - Explosive(s) + Heal Potion(s) + Arrow(s) + Cure Potion(s) 
          + Refresher(s)
Boss    - None
=================

When you enter, there is a Scorpion, and an edgehog, on the left,
blocking a chest with exlosives in it. To progress into the cave, take
out the scorpion on the right, and head in that direction. Keep going,
until you reach soem stairs. Walk up them, and take out the Edgehog on
top of them. A little farther to the left, is a Land Worm, defeat it,
and head down the path it was blocking.

The grtound will crumble, and hero will slip! Phoebe however, grabs on
to the wall with her Cat Claw. After seeing this, she'll give you the
Cat Claw, and switch her own weapon to the Bow and Arrows. Now you'll be
able to climb up walls with the hand grips on them, as well as use it 
in battle.

Just to the right of where you land, is a ledge you can climb. There's a
chest of Heal Potions on top. Pick them up, and you have a chance to get
some items. This next part is optional, but: Climb back up, head to the 
left, and fight a Centaur blocking the stairs, or go all the way down 
gain, head left, and fight a Scorpion. If you fight the Scorpion, climb
the wall behind him, to reach the platform with the Centaur, except,
behind the Centaur (so, you don't have to fight him.)

There's a Land Worm, and a Centaur on the right, who block a chest with
three potions inside. Head back to the left, and bomb the barricaded 
doorway, on the wall. Walk through, and take out the Land Worm in the 
next room, proceeding to battle your way across, to the treasure chests.
One contains potions, and the other contains arrows.

Now, back to the mandatory stuff. Leave the room, and climb the wall
to the left, as far as you can, and drop onto another platform. Defeat
the Edgehog here, as well as the land worm a little after him. If you 
keep going south, you can find a Centaur blocking a chest with a few
Refreshers inside. Back near the top of the platform, on the left, is a
Scorpion blocking climbable wall. Take him out, and begin scaling the
wall. Move to the left, and drop down onto the floor again, where you 
should kill the Edgehog.

Climb the wall left of the Edgehog, and fight a Scorpion on the platform
above. Keep climbing, and take care of another Edgehog at the top. Bomb
the rocks he was blocking, to reveal another door to go through. The
next room has an array of enemies. If you fight to the right, from the
entrance, you can get two chests, one with arrows, and one with potions.
If you battle to the top of  the area, you can turn right, to reach a 
new part of the room. In the bottom of this area, two chests, containing
Arrows and Heal Potions. On the top, the stairs to the next, and final,
room.

You start under a sheet of ice in the next room. Fight the enemies, so
you can reach the platform in the middle of the room (the chest contains
arrows.) On the center platform, you'll find the boss of this area.

               O-------------------------------------O
               |           Squidite - 2,500HP        |
O--------------O-------------------------------------O----------------O
| EXP: 219     | Battle Strategy: Start off, by using Hero to take out|
| GP: 6        | both of the Sparna he's with. Every turn, while she  |
O--------------O still has Wizard Magic, use Phoebe's Thunder magic.  |
| Attack List  | attack. When t he Sparnas are gone, have Hero bomb   |
| ===========  | him. Squidite can do over 200 damage in one attack,  |
| Blackness    | sometimes, as well as blinod you, and lower your     |
| Choke Up     | magic. Stick with the above strategy, and you'll be  |
| Electrapulse | fine, though.                                        |
O--------------O------------------------------------------------------O

After you defeat Squidite, a chest will appear where he once stood. 
Inside, is the Libra Crest! Take the crest, and you're ready to leave 
Wintry Cave. Retrace your steps, to the exit. Before you continue, 
though, you might want to do a little more training, on the Battlefield
to the west of Wintry Cave.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Battlefield            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Desert Hag
Reward - 600 GP
=================

This Battlefield contains only one type of enemy, but it's one you
haven't faced yet, the Desert Hag. Watch out for their counter attacks,
and remember, they are weak against fire, if you need to use magic. By
clearing out 10 battles, you'll win 600 GP! When you're done, head back
to the Libra Temple.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|      Libra Temple + Life Temple     |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - Arrow(s) + Cure Potion(s)
Boss    - None
=================

Check the treasure chest, to pick up some arrows, then step onto the
crest in the middle of the room. You'll be trasnported to the Life 
Temple (although, it's blocked form the rest of the world, take the
southern exit, to see where you are on the map.) You'll find out that
the Healing Spring has dried up! Head through the door on the top of
the room, to meet - again - that cloaked man.

Talk to him, and he'll give you that bag of what Wakewater is left,
and then leave. Check the chest for 3 potions, and then step back on
the crest, to transport back to Libra temple. Leave, and go back to
Aquaria now.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|                Aquaria              |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - Heal Potion(s) + Refresher(s) + Cure Potion(s) + Explosive(s)
Boss    - None
=================

When you enter the area, you'll automatically move to the center
platform, and use the Wakewater on a leaf. The leaf will revive, but the
town stays frozen. It looks like you have to head to the Ice Pyramid
now. First stop on this trip: Falls Basin, just north of Aquaria! And
remember, all items are in the same locations as the last time you 
visited the town.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|             Falls Basin             |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Desert Hag + Lamia
Items   - Explosive(s) + Blizzard [Spell]
Boss    - Snow Crab
=================

Start, by pushing the ice block in front of you 9 sapces north, and then
left, until it reachs a wall. Push it one more space north, and then 
walk around it, and through a door, in the wall of ice. Take out the
Desert Hag, and walk up the stairs he was blocking, and out the door on
the other side.

Jump onto the ice block you just pushed, and onto a nother platform on
the other side. Begin moving downward, until you reach the botom, at
which point, you should move right, and defeat the Lamia, to reach the
second ice block. Move it 4 spaces to the east, then push it up one
space, so that it's between the two platforms. Turn around, and go back
up the stairs you were just at. From here, move to the right side of
the paltform, and jump across the ice block, to the next platform.

Take the stairs down, and defeat the Lamia, and push the second block
in this sequence: 3 West, 1 North, 2 Left, 6 North, 10 Right. Now, push
the the block you pushed before this one (the one between the two
platforms on the bottom of the screen) below this one. Finally, go back
to the very first block, and move it in this sequence: 1 East, 1 South,
8 East, 1 North, 3 East, 1 North.

Head back to the stairs, on the platform in the lower right hand corner
of the area, and jump across the first two ice blocks, taking out the
Desert Hag. Continue going forward, and go through the door in the ice
wall. There's a chest containing some bombs, and a Lamia for you to 
fight. Leave the room, through the second door, and jump across the
ice block, to the next platform. Go around the Snow Crab, and get the
Heal Spell from the chest, and then go back to fight the crab.

               O-------------------------------------O
               |         Snow Crab - HP 3,000        |
O--------------O-------------------------------------O----------------O
| EXP: 234     | Battle Strategy: Snow Crab has two desert hags with  |
| GP: 3        | him, when you fight. Have Hero use his bombs on all  |
O--------------O of them, while Phoebe uses Thunder, on Snow Crab     |
| Attack List  | alone. If Phoebe runs out of magic, and have no seeds|
| ===========  | use her arrows. Make sure to heal, when you're low   |
| Full Nelson  | on HP, because this guy's attacks do over 200 damage |
| Giant Blade  | and Tornado can do around 600 (usually less)! If he  |
| Icy Foam     | confuses you, heal it. You don't want to lose control| 
| Stare        | in this battle. Keep doing damage, and using Hero to |
| Tornado      | heal whenever sufficient damage is done to your team,|
|              | and you'll come out of the fight victorious.         |
O--------------O------------------------------------------------------O

After you defeat the Snoe Crab, Phoebe will give you another item. The
Jumbo Bombs! These are really poweful, so why wasn't she using them in
place of those arrows...? Well, it doesn't matter. You can use them now!
Head out the door above, and you'll be on your way to the Ice Pyramid (
Or the Battlefield that's in front of it.)

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Battlefield            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Lamia + Mage + Desert Hag
Reward - 540 EXP
=================

This battlefield gives you an oppurtunity to test out your new Jumbo
Bombs, which are pretty strong. The prize is a slight boost in EXP, but
add it to the amount of EXP you gained fighting in the battles, and it
may be worth it. When you're done, heal, and continue north, to the Ice
Pyramid.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Ice Pyramid            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

section: Enemies - Desert Hag + Lamia + Mage + Phanquid + Sphinx + Stoney Roost
text:
=================
Enemies - Desert Hag + Lamia + Mage + Phanquid + Sphinx + Stoney Roost
          + Gather + Freezer Crab
Items   - Magic Mirror + Explosive(s) + Arrow(s) + Refresher(s)
          + Heal Potion(s) + Noble Armor + Knight Sword + Cure Potion(s)
          + River Coin
Boss    - Ice Golem
=================

When you first enter, the path will be blocked by walls. Check the 
statue on the right, and Phoebe will tell you she sees a switch. Stab 
the statue with your sword, and the door will open. Now, something 
important about what's ahead: the monsters are invisible. What can you
do about this? Well, you need the Magic Mirror, if you want to see them.

Go through the open door, and to the right. Head down to the wall, and
begin moving right again, as far as you can, and go north. Take the path
farthest to the right; You'll fight a few enemies you can't see yet, but
near the wll, at the end of the path is the Magic Mirror. Now you can
see the enemies! Heads back left. Take the path just left of the one you
were on, to find a Desert Hag, and a chest of bombs. Get the bombs, and
go back to the entrance of the pyramid.

This time, head left, and head south from where you see a Desert Hag.
There are two chests, one with Refreshers, and one with arrows here. Go
to where the treasure chests are, and head north, from the path on the
right. Fight the Desert Hag, and the Mage along this path, to reach a 
flight of stairs. Fight the Phanquid in the next room, to reach a chest
full of Heal Potions. Head back down the stairs, when you're done, and
backtrack to where you found the two chests before.

Head north again, but this time take the path on the left.  Follow it,
and fight the Lamia at the end. There is a Desert Hag, and a Lamia on 
the right. Take the path with the Lamia, and you'll find a Mage blocking
a set of stairs. There is a Lamia on the next floor, blocking a hidden
door. Head through it, to reach a chest with arrows inside. Head back 
down the stairs after getting them, and take the path with the Desert
Hag.

Just after defeating the Desert Hag, take an immediate right, and fight
another Lamia. Head down the path, and around the turn, to find another
Mage blocking a set of stairs. At the top, head around, behind where the
stairs are, and stab the statue on the left. A door will open, and let
you access a chest of arrows. After picking them up, take out the Lamia
on the left side of the room, and head down the path she blocked. Just
beyond her, is a Mage, and beyond him, a Phanquid blocking the next
flight of stairs. Defeat him, and continue up.

Head to your right, and defeat the first two enemies, and begin heading
downard at the turn. You can defeat the Freezer Crab, to get a treasure
chest with arrows in it on the left, and another Crab, to the south. 
Defeat the second crab, and get more arrows from the chest, then jump 
over the chest. Fight the Gather, and keep going along the path. Hit
the statue with your sword at the end of the path, to open a door.

Turn around, and go back to the stairs. This time head to your left, and
fight your way past the array of enemies, to the bottom of the area. 
Enter the door, and fight the Stoeny Roost inside,and open the two
chests, to get bombs and arrows. Come back out, and head farther to the
right, and defeat the Stoney Roost. Just beyond him, is another door.
Go through it, and take a left, to go underneath the platform. Go up
the set of stairs here, to reach the next floor.

Take a left from the start, and kill the Mage. Keep moving around, 
until you reach a Sphinx. Defeat it, and take the next flight of stairs
as well. On the next floor, walk one step ahead, to fall down, into the
blocked section of this floor. You can fight, and get the chests, which
contain Heal Potions, Arrows, Refreshers, and Potions, as well as the 
valuable, Noble Armor! It increases your defense by 12! Stab the statue
on the right, to open a door on the left, to leave the isolated area.
Move around, and head up to the next floor again, afterward.

Defeat the Sphinx onb the right, and you can get two chests, each with
10 bombs inside. On the lef,t is a Stoney Roost. Defeat him, and move
along the path, being careful not to fall. Once you reach the middle
platform (by defeating the Gather) you can head to the top of the room
to get more bombs, or on the left of the room (get there by jumping 
acorss the platforms) is a chest of cure potions.

Move back to the middle platform, and blow up the center tile with a
bomb. Jump down the hole, and continue falling down, until you reach 
the first floor. Stab one of the statues, to open the floor, and jump
down again. You'll be completely surrounded by enemies, and chests. 
Defeat one of the enemies, to get out, and possibly more, for the EXP.
The chests contain Arrows, Potions, Heal Potions, and most importantly,
in the fancy chest, the Knight Sword! Talk to the Ice Golem on the 
platform above, and he'll say he is enjoying your little "game" and 
leave. So, head to the south-east corner of the room, and go under the 
ice.

From below the ice, head to the door in the north-west part of the room.
Defeat the Lamia, and head through the door. Fight your way to the wall,
and climb it with the Cat Claw, until you reach another door at the top.
Walk acorss the stairs, until you reach another door. You can hit the
statue on the right, to reveal two chests, both contain arrows. 
Drop off the platform in the next room to reach them. At the top of the
next room, after the winding path, is the Ice Golem. Prepare for battle!

               O-------------------------------------O
               |          Ice Golem - 6,500HP        |
O--------------O-------------------------------------O----------------O
| EXP: 246     | Battle Strategy: First of all, this guy, being made  |
| GP: 0        | of ice, is obviously going to be weak against fire.  |
O--------------O So, have Phoebe and Heero use Fire every turn - that |
| Attack List  | is when they aren't healing. When you run out of     |
| ===========  | magic (and remember, Thunder works decently too) use |
| Axe Bomber   | their normal attacks. Bomb and Sword work about the  |
| Hypno Sleep  | same for Hero. Watch out for his attacks, as almost  |
| Ice Block    | all will do over 200 damage per turn - Snowstorm will|
| Mega Punch   | do that, as well as heal him. Keep healed, and you   |
| Snow Storm   | should win; You'll know he's going down when he      |
| Stomp Stomp  | begins to melt. Oh, and watch out for Stomp Stomp;   |
|              | It does HUGE damage.                                 |
O--------------O------------------------------------------------------O

When you beat him, you'll save the second crystal! Then, Pheobe will
leave, to go back to Aquaria, and see if the ice melted. Get the River
Coin from the treasure chest, and then, leave the Ice Pyramid - you'll
notice the map has changed DRASTICALLY.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|      Aquaria + Spencer's Place      |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - Heal Potion(s) + Refresher(s) + Cure Potion(s) + Venus Key 
          + Explosive(s)
Boss    - None
=================

Go back to Aquaria, and you'll find a town that seems completely
different fdrom the Aquaria you know before! Take the stairs into the
water, and move to the house on the bottom-left side of the screen. From
the water, you can go underneath the house. Do so, to enter Spencer's
Place.

When you arrive in the cave-like area, take the ladder, up onto the 
ground platform. Head south, crossing bridges, and using stairs when 
necessary. It's a long way, but its a linear path, with no monsters.
When you reach the bottom, head through to the bottom of the screen, 
and go to the second area of Spencer's Place.

Head downward, and cross the bridge on the right. Talk to the old man,
who happens to be Spencer. After some talking, he'll give you the Venus
Key, and hint you to go to Focus Tower, and ultimately, to Fireburg. By
the way, if you use the door, you can reach a chest of potions, and if
you climb the wall with the Cat Claw, you can reach the world map, but
Spencer's Place is still isolated.

So, head back up to Aquaria. Stay at the inn maybe, pick up some items
(again, as the same place as before.) By the way, you can buy bombs and
potions in the Inn, though, you can get them for free at Libra Temple.
Speaking of which, before you continue, there's a Battlefield just 
north of Libra Temple...

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Battlefield            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Phanquid + Sphinx
Reward - Exit [Spell]
=================

Even though you don't have a companion, you shouldn't have a problem
beating these guys; You've seen them all before anyway. If you do have 
a problem, you can always go back to Foresta or Aquaria to rest anyway.
Just use your Knight Sword on the enemies - Or use a Jumbo Bomb, if your
Knight Sword isn't taking out the Phanquids. Your reward, is a new 
spell! Exit!

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Battlefield            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Freezer Crab + Gather
Reward - 744 EXP
=================

Left of the previous Battlefield, is another Battlefield. Bombs are 
good here, due to the Gather's weakness. Although, the Knight Swoord 
should also work. This time, the reward is a boost in EXP. The Wintry
Temple is to the south, but you can't do anything at all in it yet. So,
head past it, and into Focus Tower by another entrance.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Focus Tower            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - Explosive(s) + Venus Shield + Blizzard [Spell] 
          + Cure Potion(s)
Boss    - None
=================

When you enter, there's a flight of stairs in front of you. Head down 
them, to talk to that cloaked man again. He'll tell you to seek a person
named Reuben in Fireburg, and then leave. You're growing used to his 
habbit of giving you only minimum information, though, aren't you?

If you bomb the door on the left, you can walk through, and get the 
Venus Shield. Well, you can as long as you got the Venus Key... You 
did, didn't you? There's also a Blizzard Spell on the left side of the
room, so get that as well.

Now, about that statue... Move it, so that it's one space right of the 
metal/stone block, on the bottom wall. This is important, any other
spot will not work. Now, leave Focuse Tower, and enter it again through
the entrance near Libra Temple. Head down the first set of stairs, go
around, and open the River Coin door; Continue ahead, through the next
door.

Head south, and if you moved the statue to the right spot, it should
still be there. Use it to jump across to the other platform. Go left,
and up, until you reach some stairs. Go through them, and check the
treasure chest for some potions. When your exit the tower, through the
door on the top wall. By the way, notice, on the world map, in this
region, when you move, there's an earthquake. You'll find out why, a
little later.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Battlefield            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Jelly
Reward - 900 GP
=================

This battlefield contais some new types of enemy; Particularly, of the
element of fire. This one contains only Jellys, so use bombs; Remember,
enemies of the Slime family hate bombs. The reward this time, is a pile
of GP. Head north, after clearing it out, to find another battlefield -
one that holds an important item as a reward.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Battlefield            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Jelly + String Rat
Reward - Gemini Crest
=================

This Battlefield contains more Jellys, as well as Sting Rats. If you 
keep a steady supply of black magic - or Jumbo Bombs, at least - you
should be able to clear this place out. By doing so, you'll be rewarded
with the Gemini Crest - another stone, to enable you to use warps with
the Gemini symbol on them! In fact, in the building in the north-west
section of Aquaria, there's a building with a Gemini Warp, leading to
Fireburg! Although, you can access fireburg from here, anyway.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Battlefield            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Plant Man
Reward - 816 EXP
=================

There's one more Battlefield between you and Fireburg now. It contains
only Plant Mans, so if you use your Axe, and are level 18 or so, one 
hit should take them out. Hack away, until the Battlefield is cleaned
out, and you'll get a reward of 816 EXP. Now, head west, to Fireburg.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|                Fireburg             |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - Refresher(s) + Multi-Key + Mega Genade + Seed(s) 
          + Explosive(s) + Battle Axe
Boss    - None
=================
