The first thing to do in this town, is to meet Reuben. Head north from
where you enter, to find a Hotel. Neighboring it, on the left, is the
house Reuben lives in. Go inside, and get some Refreshers from the
chest, then talk to Reuben. He needs you to help him rescue his dad, so
he joins you, on the condition that you'll help; Reuben joins the team!

The next order of buisness, is to get Mega Grenades from a friend of 
Reuben's dad. One problem though - The guy has locked himself in the
house. No probelm though. Enter the hotel, and walk to the back. Here,
you'll meet up with Tristam again. He'll give you a Multi-Key, and say
it should help you unlock the door of the guy's house. So, leave the
hotel, and use Cat Claw, to climb down the wall, near the outside of
the hotel, down to where a house is. This time, you'll be able to enter.

He'll give you the Mega Grenades! These bombs are strong, plus, on the
map, you can throw them! Now, you can leave the house, and exit the '
town on the left side, to gain access to the next areas. Oh, and before
you go, back in the hotel again, there's a guy that sells seeds. Seeds 
are very valuable, as you should know by now, so stock up! You can also 
buy some explosives from a man outside the inn, but they are a bit 
expensive... Most importantly, however, is a house in the southern part
of town. A lady in it, will sell you a Battle Axe for 500GP - It's very
worth it! After getting it, you can head out, to a battlefield west of
Fireburg.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Battlefield            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

section: Enemies - Plant Man + Sting Rat + Flazzard
text:
=================
Enemies - Plant Man + Sting Rat + Flazzard
Reward  - 1200 GP
=================

There's another battlefield to the west of Fireurg. This gives you a 
good chance to test out how Reuben fights. And remember, Plant Men are
weak against axe attack - And Reuben's Morning Star counts as one. If
you encounter any Flazzards, you'll probably want to use Blizzard. Clear
them all out, and you'll be getting a healthy boost in GP. Head west,
to fight one more Battlefield before reaching the Mine, afterwards.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Battlefield            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Flazzard + Red Cap
Reward  - Thunder [Spell]
=================

Again, you're going to be clearing out 10 rounds of monsters. As well as
picking up a bit of EXP and GP in the process, you'll get a very good
reward this time; Your first Wizard spell - Thunder! After you recieve 
Thunder, head north, to the Mine.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|                 Mine                |________________)
                 O=====================================O

section: Enemies - Zombie + Red Cap + Red Bone + Flazzard + Plant Man
text:
=================
Enemies - Zombie + Red Cap + Red Bone + Flazzard + Plant Man
Items   - Charm Claw + Explosive(s) + Heal Potion(s)
Boss    - Jinn
=================

When you enter, the first thing you should do, is take the conveyor 
belt, heading upward. Fight the Red Bone at the top, and head right
from there. If you bomb the door on this platform, you can enter a cave
area. On the wall, opposite the side you enter, you can climb down to
the left or right side of the cave. On both sides, are four enemies you
can face to reach treasure chests. The chest on the right contains Heal
Potions, and the one on the left contains Potions. After you get the
contents, leave the cave.

Take the conveyor belt on the right, to another platform. On the right,
is a bucket+pully type mechanism. Ride it to the bottom. On your left,
there will be two Red Bones guarding another blocked door. Defeat them
and blow up the door. Once inside, fight your way around the right side
of the rocks, to reach a room with a fancy treasure chest. Inside, is
the upgrade to the Cat Claw, the Charm Claw! Take it, and leave the
cave.

Next, Take the conveyor belt going downward, and defeat the Zombie at 
the bottom. Keep moving south, until you reach another (and the final)
optional cave; You'll know the door, as always, it's blocked by bombable
rocks. Inside, defeat the Flazzard, and the Red Cap on the right, and
move around the platform, to the wall. Climb to the floor, where you'll
fight another Red Bone, than climb up to a second platform. Either climb
over, or fight the Zombie there, to reach a chest full of bombs. Take 
them, and leave the cave; Now, you're after Jinn, the boss of the Mine!

Climb up the wall, outside the cave, and take the conveyor platform 
that's moving left. You'll be brought back to the first platform. This
time, drop down from the bucket-pulley, and take the downward-moving
coneyor belt from there, fighting the Zombie at the bottom. From here,
head right, onto another conveyor belt, again, taking out a Zombie.
Farther right, is a platform you can climb up. Do so, and take the 
conveyor belt that's moving up, and fight - You guessed it! - A zombie.
Move to to the top of the platform, and take yet another conveyor belt
to the right. On the other side, take out the Red Bone, and get ready
to fight Jinn, who's blocking the door on the next platform!


               O-------------------------------------O
               |            Jinn  - 6,000HP          |
O--------------O-------------------------------------O----------------O
| EXP: 504     | Battle Strategy: Start this fight, by taking out     |
| GP: 15       | each red bone, who are fighting with him. When that's|
O--------------O done, use Reuben to attack every turn. Hero should   |
| Attack List  | use Thunder while it lasts, and Quake, when he's     |
| ===========  | out of Wizard magic. In addition, use Hero to cure   |
| Beam         | wheenver HP gets low - Below 250 or so. If Hero dies |
| Dragon Cut   | revive him immediately. All of Jinn's attacks can be |
| Fire         | dangerous, especially Flame Pillar which does big    |
| Flame Pillar | damage to both characters. When his mouth opens, he's|
| Hypno-sleep  | starting to lose HP. When he decreases in size, he's |
|              | almost dead. Keep hitting him, and he'll die soon.   |
O--------------O------------------------------------------------------O

When he's defeated, exit the Mine through the door he was blocking. On
the outside, check the four chests, to get bombs, Potions, and Heal
Potions. Then, move to the right, to see Reuben's dad. Reuben will
throw a Mega Grendade, and cause the huge boulder to roll away (causing
you to see a short cutscene of the world map.) After he leaves, go back
into the Mine.

To get back to the entrance, defeat the Red Bone near the top of the 
paltform where you fought Jinn, and take the conveyor belt he was 
blocking. Defeat another Red Bone at the top, to access the conveyor 
belt that's moving left. On the next platform, take the belt moving 
down, and then climb up to a new platform from there. One more belt -
The one moving left - will bring you back to the first platform. Exit
the mine, and head back to Fireburg.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|                Fireburg             |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - Refresher(s) + Seed(s) + Explosive(s)
Boss    - None
=================

This time, you're here just to get some information, from Reuben's dad.
By heading back to the house you found Reuben in, you'll find Reuben's
father, lying down. If you talk to him, he'll tell you the Fire Crystal
is in the Lava Dome. You'll be going there soon, but for now, you have
another destination. 

On the worldmap, you should have noticed how the boulder you moved
earlier made a bridge to a temple? That is known as "Sealed Temple".
That's where you're going now.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|    Sealed Temple + Wintry Temple    |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - Heal Potion(s) + Cure Potion(s)
Boss    - None
=================

Inside, you'll meet that cloaked character again. This time, he's here
just for fun - He'll ask for money for coffee and then just run away!
Well fine, be like that, Mr. Cloaked man! After he leaves, get the Cure
Potions, and Healing Potions from the treasure chests in the back of the
room, then get on the Gemini warp pad, to be teleported to Wintry 
Temple.

Once in Wintry temple, you can get more Cure Potions and Heal Potions
from the chests, but nothing else. Just get back on the warp, to go to
Sealed temple again, and leave. Head north, two spots from here, to 
find another Battlefield. You're going to do some training again!

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Battlefield            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Zombie + Ghost + Red Bone
Reward  - 1200 EXP
=================

Again with the battlefields, huh? Yup. This time, you'll be facing off
against Ghosts (a new type of creature), Zombies and Red Bones. It 
shouldn't be too difficult, but remember, Zombies and Ghosts can be 
fiven large damage by White Magic or Cure Potions, if you need an edge
to help you. The reward is a boost in EXP - Not bad. When your finished,
it's time to head east, to the Volcano.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|                Volcano              |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Ghost + Red Bone + Nitemare + Were Wolf
Items   - White [Spell] + Refrsher(s) + Cure Potion(s) + Heal Potion(s)
          + Explosive(s)

Boss    - Medusa
=================

Start, by heading up the stairs on the right. At the top, there's a Ware
Wolf guarding a door. Defeat him, and walk through the door, navigating
to the left, until you come out through another door. Open the chest to
recieve the powerful White, Wizard magic! Now, head back through the 
door, to the right, and come out where you originally entered. Now, if
you defeat the ghost on the right, then move down, on the raised
platform, fighting the Were Wolf and Red Bone, you can reach two chests,
one with Hwal Potions, and one with Refrshers. If you head north, to 
another screen, via the stairs a Skeletons blocking, you can take a 
door to get some bombs. When you get them, come back down.Finally, 
before you move on, head back to where you entered. This time move left,
until you pass some stairs. Defeat the enemies, to get a few cures.

Now, the next area of the Volcano has thick gas, that will make the 
enemies invisible - Unless you have a mask, which you'll get in 
a little while, a few screens ahead from where you are now. Heads up
the stairs, that are near where you just picked up the potion, and jump
across to the next platform. Defeat the Red Bone, Ghost, and Nitemare,
then head north, to the next screen. Head left, and down the steps,
and go around throuhgh the door. Navigate to the right, until you come
out in front of a chest. Get the Heal Potions, and head right, up more
stairs, to another screen. Continue straight to get a chest with more
bombs inside. After getting them, head left, and up more stairs, to
another screen.

Beat the ghost on your left, and move up the stairs, to defeat a Ware
Wolf. Just beyond him, is the chest with the Mask inside. Now you'll be
able to see enemies through the gas on the other screens of the
volcano! Before heding back down, though, left of the stairs, is a 
Nitemare, who's blocking a chest of Cure Potions. After you get them, 
backtrack two areas, and navigate left, through the door again. From
here, head up the stairs, and defeat the Nitemare, heading up more
stairs, to the next screen. Defeat the Nitemare on your left, and
head past where he was, and go through the cave, to the right. Kill
the Ware Wolf, and head up another flight of stairs, where there's a
ghost waiting for you at the top.

Defeat the two enemies on the right, to reach a chest with 3 Cure 
Potions inside. After you get it, proceed up to the next platform. If 
you fight the Nitemare and the Ware Wolf on the left, you can reach
a chest with Heal Potions. After picking them up, head for the top 
level of the volcano. Heal, and use a Seed to regain your magic, and
get ready to fight Medusa, who's in the middle of the platform!

               O-------------------------------------O
               |           Medusa - 5,000HP*         |
O--------------O-------------------------------------O----------------O
| EXP: 510     | Battle Strategy: Make sure to start this fight, with |
| GP: 15       | Hero having a full stock of Wizard Magic. Start by   |
O--------------O taking out the two Were Wolves seperately, then have |
| Attack List  | Reuben use his Morning Star on Medusa. Have him heal |
| ===========  | himself and Hero when needed - Don't stop using      |
| Para-snake   | white with Hero. When Medusa is alone, it will do    |
| Poison Snake | 1,300+ damage (at level 22). Do this for several     |
| Screech Voice| turns, and she'll go down. Remember though, Hero is  |
| Snake Head   | the one using white - Heal him if he gets confused   |
|              | or paralyzed.                                        |
O--------------O------------------------------------------------------O
* This is an estimate. It was believed to be 2,500, but that is false.

After you beat Medusa - which isn't a terribly hard battle - move down
the stairs she was blocking. You'll go back to the world map, but now
you'll have access to a new part of the volcano - The Lava Dome! Heal
or, perhap[s go back to Fireburg to rest, than move on to the Lave Dome,
where the Fire Crystal resides.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|               Lave Dome             |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Hot Wings + Avizzard + Fangpire + Adamant Turtle + Ninja
          + Stheno + Salamand + Iflyte
Items   - Explosive(s) + Cure Potion(s) + Heal Potion(s) + Refresher(s)
          + Life [Spell] + Moon Helm + Sun Coin
Boss    - Dualhead Hydra
=================


Start by heading right, and defeating the Hot Wings. Move down to the
next platform, and defeat the Ninja. Head down another set of stairs,
and enter the cave. Fight your way to the right, until you reach some
platforms in the lava. Jump to them, and bomb the rock, and jump to 
the next platform - The one with a Stheno on it. Defeat the Stheno,
and open the chest, to reveal the valuable Life Spell! There are a 
few random chests scattered here, but nothing else that's too 
important. When you're done, exit the cave from where you entered. You 
can also take the door on the left, and drop down (after defeating an 
Iflyte - Doing this brings you to a chest with 3 refreshers.)

Head left, until you see a flight of stairs. Take them, and defeat
the Ninja at the top. Keep going left, until you defeat another Ninja.
Defeat him, and keep going (again) until you reach a cave door. Go
inside, and head to the right. You can fight some of the monsters,
but the goal is to get to the top of the room, and jump onto the 
platforms in the lava. From here, jump in front of the boulders on
the platform on your left, bomb them, and jump over. Defeat the Stheno
and head up the stairs. A few enemies later, and you'll have access
to two chests - One with 3 Cure Potions, the other with the valuable
Moon Helm armor! After getting them, either head back to where you
entered the Lava Dome, or use an Exit Spell, and re-enter.

Now, head to the left, and defeating the Hot Wings. Go into the cave 
it was blocking, and you'll see a Fangpire. After defeating him, jump 
across the stone steps in the lava, and fight the Adamant Turtle, to
reach a treasure chest with some bombs inside. Take them, and then 
leave the cave. Head down the stairs, and go to the left. There's 
another cave that you should enter here. If you do some fighting, you
can reach chests on the right; They contain Cure Potions, Heal Potions
and Refreshers. If you head right from where the chests are, and go 
around the wall, you can reach some stairs to another area, blocked by
an Avizzard. Defeat the Ninja, Fangpire, and Adamant Turtle and
the Iflyte here to reach an exit. Defeat another Iflyte outside, and
step on a switch, to open a door on another platform. Go back through
the cave, and back out the door you entered from earlier.

When you come out, drop off the ledge, to a platform below, and kill
the Avizzard that's waiting for you. After that, head down the stairs,
and go right, to the cave; Enter it. Ahead, is a treasure chest,
that contains 3 potions, but fight your way around the left-hand side
of the cave, and take out the Stheno near the end, and you'll be at a
set of stairs, leading to another cave door. In the next room, move
straight, as far as you can go, and head left. After defeating a 
Salamand, and a Stheno, you'll reach two treasure chests - One with
Cure Potions, and one with Heal Potions. Take them, and go back to the
beginning of the room. This time, take a left. Fight your way to the
stairs, and you'll be able to get a few more chests, but more
importantly, you'll reach a spot where you can jump to a platform on 
the right. Do that, and head north, and to the left, and the top, and
exit through another door. You can fight, to reach 2 chests (Both
contain Cure Potions) and then leave, through another door on the
left.

You can climb the wall, but there's just an empty room after the Ninja,
so take the stairs on the left. Kill the Avizzard at the top, and enter
the cave. From here, you have to head down two flights of stairs, and
into the next room. This room is another room with treasure chests
thrown around - You can seek them out, if you want. To actually reach
the next exit though, defeat the Hot Wings, and head down the first 
flight of stairs. From here, go a bit left, and down to the bottom
of the screen, where you can climb some stairs, and defeat the Salamand
at the top. Jump to the platform on the right, defeat the Hot Wings,
and go down the stairs, next. Afterwards, defeat the Hot Wings, and go
up the next stairs, defeat the Ninja, and jump to the left. It's a 
linear path - with a Salamand on it - to the exit. From the outside,
head through the large door, into a room with lots of lava.

First, walk straight ahead, and defeat the Salamand. From here, you 
can jump across rocks, on both the left and right sides - A little
out, both sides fork anyway. There are cure potions on the noth-west
corner of the room, a Stheno and Cure Potions on the South-east, and
the Dualhead Hydra in the top-middle - No it isn't an item, it's a 
boss!

               O-------------------------------------O
               |       Dualhead Hydra- 14,000HP      |
O--------------O-------------------------------------O----------------O
| EXP: 429     | Battle Strategy: First of all, make sure you have    |
| GP: 0        | the Moon Helm - Being strong against fire attacks is |
O--------------O a must! That being said, the basic strategy for this |
| Attack List  | battle, should be to have Hero use White every turn, |
| ===========  | while Reuben uses his Morning Star, or heals when it |
| Fire Breath  | becomes necessary. Also, keep both characters alive  |
| Para-breath  | and un-petrified at all times! A focused Fire Breath |
| Poison Breath| can be very deadly. As one head falls off, and the   |
| Scrunch      | other takes a different position, he is approaching  |
| Stone Gas    | death. Keep attacking, until he's gone. Also, as a   |
|              | note, if you run out of Seeds, have Reuben keep      |
|              | attacking, while Hero does the healing.              |
O--------------O------------------------------------------------------O

After the battle's over - Assuming you won of course - you'll save the
Fire Crystal! You'll also see a lava flow do some changes on the world
map, as well as here that you should head toward Windia next. Open the
chest to get the Sun Coin, then either leave, or use exit. You should
notice a new Battelfield. Of course, now you'll have to clear it out!

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Battlefield            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Stheno + Iflyte
Reward  - 1068 EXP
=================

For whatever reason, this place has lots of "Unexpected Attacks". So
don't enter, without at least some HP. You may want to use White, to
help you take care of the battles a little quicker. Once you've cleared
this place out, and you'll get a boost in EXP. Now, you're going back to
Focus Tower!

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|      Focus Tower + Doom Castle      |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Shadow
Items   - Aegis Shield
Boss    - 
=================

In Focus Tower, make your way to the set of colored doors. With the Sun
Coin, you'll be able to open the third one (purple.) Open it, and you'll
get to talk to that cloaked man again. He'll tell you to look out for
Mac's ship as you go to Windia. With that, he'll leave, and you can take
the stairs. Walk straight ahead in this area, and you'll reach another
set of stairs. Go through, to enter Doom Castle - Well, only one room of 
it actually! Defeat the Minotar Zombie, and open the chest, to recieve
the Aero spell. Now, you can leave the room. Head back to where you met
the Cloaked Man just now, and walk around the stairs, on the right, 
through a door on the bottom of the screen. Welcome to the next region
of the world; NExt stop: Rope Bridge!

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Rope Bridge            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Mummy
Items   - Cure Potion(s) + Seed(s)
Boss    - None
=================

When you begin, attempt to walk across the bridge. A mummy will appear,
and Reuben will try to play the role of a Hero, and defend you. He ends
up being knocked off the bridge though, leaving you to fight alone -
Not that the Mummy is strong. Defeat it, and Hero will automatically
climb down, to see Reuben. He says he'll catch up later - and then
who should come by, but Tristam. You're not alone anymore - hooray!

Continue crossing the bridge - Make sure to climb down the second vine
if you want some Cure Potions. You'll also want to climb down the fifth
and final vine - There are 3 seeds at the bottom. Grab the seeds, then
climb back up the vine, and exit the area from the right side. On the
world map, head right, to Alive Forest.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|       Alive Forest + Foresta        |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Mummy + Specter
Items   - Cure Potion(s) + Heal Potion(s) + Ninja Star(s) + Refresher(s)
          + Giant's Axe
Boss    - None
=================

If you cut some trees, just above wheree you start, you can reach a
Mummy and a Specter. They're blocking a treasure chest which contains
Cure Potions. After you get it - or decided not to - head to the bottom
of the area, where you'll find a Mummy blocking a bridge. Defeat the
Mummy, and cross the bridge. Also, note: There are crest symbols in 
this area that you don't have yet. Don't worry about them yet.

On the other side of the bridge, there's a Specter for you to defeat.
From here, head left and cut some trees down, to reach a chest with 3
Heal Potions inside. If you cut some trees heading downward, you'll see
a Specter blocking a lone tree. Defeat him, and chop down the tree to
reach a warp. Step on it, to enter a room with a chest of Refreshers 
(This is actually part of Foresta, though you can't leave the 
building.) 

After getting the cures, and the Refreshers, head back to the right -
Again, clearing a path by cutting down trees. Defeat either the Specter
or the Mummy (or both) at the edge of the set of trees, Talk to the
tree with a face, and Tristam will say Kaeli should be able to get a
response from him - She's in Aquaria. Before you leave, though, fight
the Mummy on the right, and cut down the lone tree. Step on the warp
underneath - you have a stone for this kind - to enter a room with a
chest of Ninja Stars inside.A little north, there's a Specter guarding
a chest of Refreshers. Now, you still have one thing left to get,
before you leave.

From where the large tree is, head left, and cut trees, heading south,
until you reach another large tree - Though, this one isn't alive -
with a fancy treasure chest near it. Cut your way around it, and kill
the Specter and the Mummy, to reach a chest with the Giant's Axe in it.
With your new weapon, head back to Aquaria.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|      Aquaria + Spencer's Place      |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - Heal Potion(s) + Refresher(s) + Cure Potion(s) + Exlposive(s) 
Boss    - None
=================

Once in Aquaria, immediately head back to Spencers Place. Climb down
the stairs and ladders, until you reach the place where you met
Spencer, a little ways back. Talk to Spencer, and Tristam will leave
you alone - Again. He will lgive you his Dragon Claw though, which is 
a  great deal!

Next, Phoebe comes, and uses a bomb, causing the tunnell to collapse!
Head back up to Aquaria, and go inside Phoebe's house. Grab some Heal
Potions from the chest, and talk to Kaeli, and she'll join you. Back
to Alive Forest you go!

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|      Alive Forest + Giant Tree      |________________)
                 O=====================================O

section: Enemies - Mummy + Specter + Live Oak + Snipion + Leech + Ooze + Skuldier
text:
=================
Enemies - Mummy + Specter + Live Oak + Snipion + Leech + Ooze + Skuldier
Items   - Cure Potion(s) + Heal Potion(s) + Explosive(s) + Refresher(s)
          + Meteor [Spell]
Boss    - Gidrah
=================

Head through the forst - remember, you can stop and pick up the same
items as before - until you reach the large tree with a face. Talk to
him, and He'll say you can pass if you defeat the monsters inside of
him. You can enter through his mouth.

Head straight from where you enter, and defeat either (or both) the 
Specter or the Mummy. A little farther ahead, is a Live Oak, guarding
a chest of Refreshers. If you fight the enemies to the right from where
you enter, you'll reach a chest with Cure Potions inside. After getting
the items you want, head left from where you entered. Defeat the Mummy
and the Live Oak. Farther on the left, a Live Oak and a Specter block
two chests - One with Heal Potions, the other with Cure Potions. After
picking them up, continue north, and to the right. Defeat a Live Oak
to reach some climbable wall, and defeat another at the top. From 
there, use your Dragon Claw to grapple to the platform to the south. 
Grapple south again, then, go  continue around the room, until you 
reach a platform with a door on it - Go through the door.

On the next floor, start by heading to the right, and killing the Live
Oak, that's blocking a treasure chest that contains heal potions.
From where you get the heal potions, go south, defeating the Live Oak,
the Snipion, and the Mad Toad. Walk through the door, into another room,
and cut a path through the mushrooms to the left. Defeat another Mad 
Toad, and you'll reach a chest with bombs, and a chest with Cure 
Potions. Take them, and go back to the entrance of the room. Cut some
'shrooms going downward, and fight your way around the room, where you
can leave through another door. Open the fancy chest to get the Meteor
spell, than backtrack through the mushroom room. Head to the left side
of the room, and grapple across the hole in the floor, then, defeat the
Live Oak. Walk to the right, and defeat the Mad Toad, which is blocking
a chest of Cure Potions, then, climb up the wall. Grapple to the
platform on the left. Stab the door to open it, and walk through.

Right of where you enter, is a chest of Heal Potions. Grab them, and
climb down to the floor. Defeat the snipion and the Mad Toad on your
left, to reach a chest of Cure Potions, and a chest of heal potions.
Get the potions, then climb back up to where you entered. Defeat the
Leech, and grapple to the platform on the left. Walk along this
platform to the right, defeating the three Leeches, until you reach 
a door - Stab it, and walk through it. You'll be in another room with
lots of mushrooms. In the room, there are two chests- one with Heal
Potions, one with Cure Potions, but to reach the door, head North-west
and climb the wall. Drop downa little to the left, and move south,
defeating the two Leeches. In the next room, walk left, and fight the
Mad Toad, to reach the pit. Climb down the vine, and defeat the Mad
Toad to reach chest of Heal Potions. Then walk north, and through 
another door.

Defeat the Mad Toad and the Leech from where you enter, and head north.
Begin scaling the wall, heading to the right. When you reach a 
platform, to the right, at the top of the wall, defeat the Leech, and
stab the door to open it. Walk through the opening to reach the fourth
floor of the Giant Tree. 

When you enter the room, head south. Defeat the two Skuldiers, and the
Ooze. You'll reach a wall with three doors on it. Go through the one in
the middle, and hack your way through the mushrooms, going clockwise 
around the middle platform. When you reach it, climb up the wall, and
kill another Ooze. Defeat a second Ooze on the left, to reach a chest 
of Heal Potions, then leave through the door. When you come out, walk
around the top of the platform, defeating the enemies, until you reach
a climbable wall. Climb it, and go through the door. Before you enter 
it though, you can walk around the door to the left, to get two more
treasure chests.

On the fifth floor, you'll be surrounded by Skeletons when you enter.
In the south end of the room, there is a chest of Cure Potions, and a
chest of Heal Potions. In the north-west corner, there's a chest of
bombs, and a chest of Healing Potions. After you get these, heal up,
and climb the wall at the top of the room, to reach the boss of this
area.

               O-------------------------------------O
               |          Gidrah - HP 13,000         |
O--------------O-------------------------------------O----------------O
| EXP: 729     | Battle Strategy: Start by having both Kaeli and Hero |
| GP: 18       | use Aero, to take out the two Skuldiers that are     |
O--------------O with Gidrah. After they're gone have Hero use Aero,  |
| Attack List  | as well as do the Healing/Curing. If he runs out of  |
| ===========  | black magic, use White, it does about the same amount|
| Para-gas     | of damage as Aero does. Have Kaeli use Aero every    |
| Stone Gas    | turn as well, only breaking the pattern if she has to|
| Three Heads  | revive Hero, or cure him from Petrification. When one|
| Tornado      | then two of the heads dissappear, he's getting low   |
|              | on HP. Launch a few more spells at him, and he should|
|              | keel over soon.                                      |
O--------------O------------------------------------------------------O

After you defeat the Gidrah, talk to the face that is behind where he
was. You'll see a cutscene of the Tree actually walking across the world
map, to a temple. Use Exit, or backtrack through the tree, to reach the
world map, where you can now enter Kaidge Temple.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|             Kaidge Temple           |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - Cure Potion(s)
Boss    - None
=================

Climb up the wall inside the temple, and talk to the man with the cape
again. He'll mention Captain Mac, and leave again. You can walk through
the door, and navigate left, and upward, to reach a chest with some
Cure Potions, but that's all you can do in here, for now. So, get the
potions, and leave the Temple. There's a Battlefield for you to train 
at, to the east. That's where you should go next.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Battlefield            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Ooze + Skuldier + Water Hag
Reward - 2808 EXP
=================

This battlefield isn't so bad. You'll be facing a new enemy though, the
Water Hag. Use a mix of your Mega Grenades, and your Aero spell to clear
out the battlefield. Remember, do not use spells on Oozes, they reflect
it back at you. When you win, you'll get a boost in EXP. Now, you should
head east to another Battlefield that you can train at, for some more 
EXP, before heading to Windia.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Battlefield            |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Water Hag + Vampire
Reward - 2808 EXP
=================

So now, you're up against Water Hags and vampires. Aero's effective 
against Vampires, but not the Water Hags. Just slash them up with your
Giant's Axes. Using Meteor or White is also a good strategy if you have
the Wizard Magic to spare (then again, you can always refresh in Windia
anyway.) When you clear them out, you'll get another EXP boost. After
it's cleared out, head north, to Windia.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|                 Windia              |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - Cupid Locket + Explosive(s) + Heal Potion(s) + Cure Potion(s) 
          + Refresher(s)

Boss    - None
=================

The first thing you should do when you enter Windia, is enter the house
on the left. Talk to the Blue Haired girl, and she'll sell you a Cupid
Locket for 300 GP - That's a good deal. If you want, you can also talk
to the man in the house, to buy some Explosives. When you're done, exit
the house, and head to the right, Enter the small house, on the right
side of town, and inside, you can talk to Otto. He'll tell you, that 
his daughter is lost on the mountain - That will be where you head next.
Before you go, though, rest up at the Inn. There's even some Refreshers
Refreshers and Heal potions in the room when you wake up - Not bad.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|           Windhole Temple           |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - Heal Potion(s)
Boss    - None
=================


Heading south and east from Windia, you can reach Mount Gale - which is
your next stop. Along the way though, is Windhole temple. The place is
empty, except for one chest of Heal Potions in the center, but you may
want them, none-the-less. After picking them up, leave, and head north
to Mount Gale.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|              Mount Gale             |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - Water Hag + Vampire + Skuldier
Items   - Heal Potion(s) + Refresher(s) + Apollo Helm
Boss    - Dullahan
=================

When you enter, head right, past the first set of stairs. Keep going 
until you reach a second set. Head upward from here, and defeat the 
Vampire to reach a chest that contains Heal Potions. Head back down the
stairs, and go east again, to a third set of stairs. Defeat the Water 
Hag at the top of them. From here, climb two more sets of Stairs, and
kill the Skuldier. Keep heading north, and grapple when you reach the
edge of the platform, then jump to another platform on the right. From
here, head south, and kill another Water Hag, and go down more stairs.

At the bottom, head right, and kill the Vampire blocking more stairs.
If you head up to the right, you can grapple to another paltform, and
defeat another Vampire to reach a chest of Refreshers. After getting
them, grapple back to the left. From here, move south, until you go
down more stairs, then head right, going up another flight of stairs,
with a Skuldier on top. Defeat him, and cross the bridge to the left.
Here, defeat the Water Hag, and head north. Grapple to the next 
platform, and defeat the Vampire to access a fancy chest with the
Apollo Helm inside. Take it, and defeat the Water Hag. Jump to the
platform on the left, and from here, grapple back to the first 
platform. Head to the middle platform, heal, and get ready to fight
Dullahan, the boss of the area!

               O-------------------------------------O
               |         Dullahan - 14,000HP         |
O--------------O-------------------------------------O----------------O
| EXP: 750     | Battle Strategy: Time for another boss. On the first |
| GP: 21       | round, have both Kaeli and Hero use Aero, to kill the|
O--------------O Vampires off. Now it's just you and Dullahan. Have   |
| Attack List  | Hero use Meteor ever turn, while Kaeli uses Aero. If |
| ===========  | Hero gets put to sleep, gets killed, or damaged alot,|
| Doom Dance   | have Kaeli heal him immediately, butonly have Hero   |
| Hypno-sleep  | cure Kaeli if she gets killed. You'll need both      |
| Headdoomerang| characters at all time, in case he does Doom Dance - |
| Rapier       | an instant death move. In a few inutes, and a few    |
| Thunder Beam | Meteors later, his horse will fall. This means he's  |
|              | losing HP. Keep hitting him with Meteor and Aero, and|
|              | he'll get off his horse completely. A few more spells|
|              | and the headless knight will fall.                   |
O--------------O------------------------------------------------------O

As it turns out, Dullahan didn't have the Wind Crystal or the girl. The
area wasn't completely fruitless though - Now, you know that Pazuzu, an
enemy you'll meet later does. So, use Exit or backtrack to the world 
map, and go back to Windia - You'll notice the wind isn't blowing so
hard now.

________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|                 Windia              |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - Explosive(s) + Heal Potion(s) + Cure Potion(s) + Seed(s)
Boss    - None
=================

When you arrive back in Windia, talk to Otto again. He'll start up the
Rainbow Road, allowing you to access Pazuzu's Tower! Leave the house,
and head north through town. Take the North Exit, to reach Pazuzu's 
Tower. Remember to stop at the Inn, and rest, as well as talking to the
old lady outside, to buy some Seeds - Buy as many as you can, so you
don't need to stock up later.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|            Pazuzu's Tower           |________________)
                 O=====================================O

section: Enemies - Garuda + Beholder + Manticore + Chimera + Thanatos + Sorcerer
text:
=================
Enemies - Garuda + Beholder + Manticore + Chimera + Thanatos + Sorcerer
          + Naga
Items   - Explosive(s) + Flare [Spell] + Excalibur + Sky Coin
Boss    - Pazuzu
=================

When you first enter, head up to the platform on the right, and talk to
the little girl. She turns out to be Norma, and when you tak to her, she
returns home. Don't leave yet though, you still need to get the Wind 
Crystal! After you rescue her, fight your way up, thorugh the center of
the room, and talk to the large bird creature, who is actually Pazuza.
He'll then run away. Go back to where you found Norma, and take the door
on the right. Defeat the Beholder, and go up the stairs.

When you enter the second floor, defeat the Garuda, and begin climbing
the stairs in front of you. Defeat another on a platform between stairs,
and keep going. At the top of the stairs, is another door. You're now
at the third floor - Fast huh? Head to the left, until you meet a 
Beholder. From here, head south, and kill the Manticore. Move to the
right from here, and defeat the Chimera. Go through the door on the
right, and fight some more enemies, moving upward, into another room.
Defeat one/some of the enemies, and take the Explosives from the chests.
When you're done, leave the room, and head bac to the left, and go 
around the wall, to the door (You'll have to defeat a Chimera, Beholder,
and a Manticor to get there.)

You'll enter the fourth floor - which is a stairway like the second 
floor. Head to the top, killing some Beholders on the way. From here,
go through the door to reach the fifth floor. Defeat the Gardua, and
walk around the platform you enter on. Go through the door, and head 
up another flight of stairs. Guess what? The sixth floor is yet another
set of stairs! Climb up them, defeating the Manticores, until you reach
the seventh floor. Kill the Sorcerer on the left, and go left. Grapple
to another platform a little north, and defeat the Thanatos. Go up the
stairs, and defeat the Sorcerer and the Chimera. Keep fighting enemies,
until you reach some stairs on the right. Go down them, and then go down
some more stairs, to the 6th floor again.

The first thing to do when you enter this area, is to defeat the 
Sorcerer, and head down the stairs. Then, defeat the Naga, and go
through the door to the south. In the next room, grab some Cure Potions
from the chest, and defeat the Naga, and the Sorcerer, to reach a fancy
chest, which is on the left side of the room. Inside, is the final 
Wizard spell, Flare! Pick it up, and bomb open the wall on the right.
Defeat the Naga on the other side, and then defeat the Sorcerer. Head
forward, and talk to Pazuzu, who will flee again, then turn around, 
and hit the switch with your axe. Go back to where you bombed the door,
and head left, and through the door near where you got the Flare spell.
Kill the Naga, and the Sorcerer, and keep going, until you reach a set
of stairs - Climb down them.

Defeat the Thanatos, and move south. Kill the Sorcerer and the Garuda
on your right, and head along the ledge they were on. At the end, jump
to the platform on the right. Farhter to the right, you can head down
some steps, and reach chests that contain Explosives and Heal Potions.
Afterwards, go back upwards, and defeat the Thanatos, to reach another
flight of stairs.

Defeat the Gargolye near where you enter, and move south. On the right,
after defeating some more monsters, is a door. Fight the Sorcerer, and
head through it. Defeat a Chimera or two, and another Sorcerer, to get
to anotherfancy chest.Open it, to get the incredibly strong Excalibur
sword! Now, leave the room, and go through the door on the right. Here,
there's a blocked door - You know the drill. Blow it open, and head 
forward, killing the Gargoyles, until you meet Pazuzu again. Grab the
Cure and Heal Potions, and talk to him - He'll run away yet again. When
he leaves, head south again, and go to the left, defeating the Sorcerer.
From here, head north, kill the Chimera, and hit the switch. After you
do that, head down the stairs near the switch, and head down the stairs,
taking care of the Thanatoses on the way.

In the next room, defeat the Naga and the Garegoyle, and go through the
door to the south. Here, there's another bombed door, but don't worry 
about that that, just head past it, and go through the door. There's
another door on the right - Go there for soem more Cure and Heal Potions,
then heads up the path on the left of it, killing the monsters, and hit
the switch. Now, head dowm, and take the stairs, back to the first floor.
Just take s right, the same stairs you took to floor 2 earlier, and 
make your way back to floor 5 - you shouldn't have to fight anyone, you
did this before already. Here, you can talk to Pazuzu again. This time,
he won't run though! Make sure to heal, and save, then get ready to go.

               O-------------------------------------O
               |           Pazuzu  - 25,000HP        |
O--------------O-------------------------------------O----------------O
| EXP: 618     | Battle Strategy: Pazuzu can do some big damage, with |
| GP: 0        | his attacks, but at least he fights alone, and has a |
O--------------O weakness - Wind. Use Aero each turn, and between the |
| Attack List  | two characters, you should be able to do 3,000 damage|
| ===========  | or so, per turn. His attacks will easily hit for over|
| Hurricane    | 500 though, so when you get low on HP, take a break  |
| Piledriver   | from attacking, and heal yourself. Also, cure every  |
| Psycheshield | time he uses Psyche Shield - if you attack, he'll    |
| Sky Attack   | repel it, which is always bad. Wait until he stops,  |
| Windstorm    | then start slamming him again, until he dies.        |
O--------------O------------------------------------------------------O

When you defeat Pazuzu, you'll automatically begin moving through the 
tower shaft. At the top, you free the Sky Crystal! Open the chest, to
get the Sky Coin, then backtrack through the castle and leave, or cast
Exit, for a quicker route. It's time to head back to Windia.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|                 Windia              |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - Explosive(s) + Heal Potion(s) + Cure Potion(s) + Seed(s)
Boss    - None
=================

Go into Otto's house, and talk to Otto, when you arrive. Who should
come to greet you, but Reuben! Kaeli leaves, allowing Reuben to take
her place as your parner, ans you're told to get the Thunder Rock
from Arion, who's at Reuben's house. You'll be going to Fireburg now.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|                Fireburg             |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - Refresher(s) + Seed(s) + Explosive(s) + Thunder Rock
Boss    - None
=================

When you arrive in Fireburg, go to Reuben's house - It's the one to the
left of the Hotel. Talk to the man who's lying down in the bed, and 
he'll give you the thunder Rock that you need. Take it, and do whatever
else you need to do in town, like maybve buy some Seeds or Explosives,
then leave, and head back to Windia.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|                 Windia              |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - Explosive(s) + Heal Potion(s) + Cure Potion(s) + Seed(s)
Boss    - None
=================

Again, go to Otto's house, and talk to Otto. He'll go to the basement,
and power up his machine, and come back shortly. He'll say you can now
access Spencer's place! Leave the town, and sure enough, there's a 
second rainbow path, just north of Pazuzu's Tower, heading to Spencer's
Place. Enter Spencers Place - It's your next destination.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|            Spencer's Place          |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - Monius Crest
Boss    - None
=================

As soon as you enter, Reuben changes the whole layout with a Mega 
Grenade, causing the world map to flood, freeing Mac's Ship! Don't 
leave just yet though. First, walk forward, and get into the water. Go
left, and blimb up onto another platform. Toss a Mega Grenade at the
blocked door, and go back to the water, and back to where you entered
the cave,

Jump to the platform on the left, and bomb the barricaded door. Go 
through, and step on the Libra warp pad, to be  brought to another part 
of the cave. Go through the door, and navigate left. There's a fancy
chest here, containing the last Crest, the Mobius Crest. Step on the
warp near the chest, to be brought to the entrance of the cave again.
Now, you can leave. You should now head back to Windia, for a moment.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|          Windia + Ship Dock         |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - Explosive(s) + Heal Potion(s) + Cure Potion(s) + Seed(s)
          + Captain Cap
Boss    - None
=================

Again, head to Otto's house. This time, you'll be talking to Kaeli
though. She'll give you the Captain Cap, and tell you to give it to
her father, Captain Mac. That's the only item you need here, so leave
the house. Don't leave town yet, though. Enter the town that's in the
north-east section of town, and go downstairs. Step on the Mobius pad,
to be brought to the Ship Dock - Also, make sure to grab Bombs and 
Heal Potions from the chest. Nothing to do at the Dock, but head north,
and board the Ship.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|         Mac's Ship + Windia         |________________)
                 O=====================================O

=================
Enemies - None
Items   - Explosive(s) + Heal Potion(s) + Cure Potion(s) + Refresher(s)
Boss    - Chimera + Thanatos + Naga + Beholder + Manticor + Gargoyle
=================

You'll enter the ship's deck on the right. Head towards the middle, 
near the stearing wheel, and go down, if you want some bombs. They're
in a chest, at the southern tip of the ship. After that, go back to
where the wheel is, and head upward, and kill the Chimera. Take a 
right, and kill the Thanatos, then push the barrell away, to reach a
chest with Heal Potions inside. Also, from here, you have acccess to
the pole. You can actually climb that, so do so. Climb up, and over
the brown pole, pass over the grey one, and climb down another brown
one, between two Thanatos. Defeat one or both of them, grab some Heal
Potions from the chest, and go down the stairs.

You'll enter a very tiny room. Just take the other set of stairs, as
it's the only thing in there. From here, head straight down, and kill
the Thanatos, and keep going, going up another flight of stairs. In the
next room, you reach a fork. If you go right, the floor will break, 
causing you to fall, and it's a waste of effort. If you do fall, fight
your way to the dock, and start over. If you want, you can jump over it 
though, and get the chest, which contains Refreshers. To move on, just 
take the stairs on the left.

On the next floor, walk straight ahead, and defeat the Gargoyle. After
that, head up the stairs, and onto a new floor. Open the fancy chest 
that's in plain sight, to get Gaia's Armor, then walk downward, and 
talk to Captain Mac. He'll see the cap, just as Kaeli walks in.  Before
he can tell you something important, Kaeli takes him away. Just after
that, Reuben collapses. You're automatically brought back to Ship Dock
Step on the Mobius pad to go to Windia. Go to the Inn, and talk to
Phoebe. Reuben will leave, and Phoebe will join in place of him. Rest 
for the night, to heal, then talk to Mac, who's lying down. He'll tell 
you you an take his ship. With this knowledge, go to the world map, and
head back to Mac's ship, and take the wheel! You'll reach a new entrance
to Focus Tower.

 ________________O=====================================O________________
(________________|      Focus Tower + Doom Castle      |________________)
                 O=====================================O

section: Enemies - Shadow + Gorgon + Minotar Zombie + Phanquid + Iflyte + Cerberus
text:
=================
Enemies - Shadow + Gorgon + Minotar Zombie + Phanquid + Iflyte + Cerberus
          + Stheno + Freezer Crab + Chimera
Items   - Aegis Shield + Arrow(s) + Refresher(s) + Heal Potion(s)  
          + Cure Potion(s)
Sub-Boss- Skullrus Rex + Stone Golem + Twinhead Wyvern + Zuh
Boss    - Dark King
=================

The first thing to do, is set your sights on getting the Aegis Shield. 
Go to the left, and defeat the Shadow at the start. Keep going up and 
to the right from here, until you reach the last (sixth) set of stairs.
Go down them, and allow the floor to move you downward, until you reach 
some bones. Walk to the left, and be pushed down more, until your near
stairs, and a pile of bones. Bomb them, and climb up to defeat the
Grogon ( You fought these in the Bone Dungeon...too easy!) and get the
chest with the sheild in it. Now,  walk acorss the sand to the left,
back to where you entered.

Again, walk to the sixth staircase, and alk down, but when you reach 
the first pair of bones, don't move. Instead, grapple to the right,
and climb the stairs, defeating the Gorgon. From here, grapple two
platforms to the left, from here, defeat the Minotar Zombie - Another
weak enemy. After beating him, climb down the wall, and walk straight 
down. Open the chest for some cures, and toss a bomb at the bones on
your left, then grapple there. Climb the stairs, and get ready to 
face the first sub-boss in this area - Skullrus Rex!

               O-------------------------------------O
               |        Skullrus Rex - 10,000 HP     |
O--------------O-------------------------------------O----------------O
| EXP: 759     | Battle Strategy: This is like a clone of the Flamerus|
| GP: 0        | Rex you fought at the Bone Dungeon, earlier. This    |
O--------------O time, two Shadows are helping him, but you also have |
| Attack List  | a new arsenal of attacks. Just use Flare and White.  |
| ===========  | The shadows will fall with your second attack, making|
| Bone Missile | the fight 1 on 2 in your favor. You'll be doing big  |
| Rip Earth    | damage, so the fight won't last long.                |
| Sleep Powder |                                                      |
| Twin Fang    |                                                      |
O--------------O------------------------------------------------------O

After beating the Skullrus Rex, go through the stairs he was blocking.
You'll be in a cave-room of Focus Tower. Go through the next set of 
stairs, and you'll be back in the main area of Focus Twoer, in front of
a green door. Open it, and walk through. Go throguh the first open door,
and you'll have just entered an ice area. Kill the Shadow on the left,
and stab the statue to open the first door.

In the next room, head left, and jump the gap to the next platform. Stab
the statue to open a door, which you can head through. Kill the Phanquid
on the other side, and stab another statue. Now, leave the room, and 
jump back across to the right. Head right from where you entered, and
grapple to the platform on the right. Go through the door, and get some
Heal Potions from the chest, and head down, at the next juntion. Grapple
downard, and stab the statue. From here, head all the way to the right,
into another room (jumping the gap when you reach it.) Stab the statue
that's here as well. Now, leave, and kill the Phanquid, and go through
the unlocked door, picking up some arrows from the chest.

Kill the Freezer Crab on the other side, and stab the statue. A door
will open, but you can't reach it from here. Go back to the middle
platform, and go through the open door. Stab the statue, and go through
the door on the left. Keep heading left, stab the statue, and jump the
gap to the left. Go around and through the "building" getting some
Frefreshers from the chest, and jump the gap. In the next room, kill
the Freezer Crab. Head through the door on top, grapple to the right,
and get ready to face the Stone Golem!

O-------------------------------------O
               |        Stone Golem - 10,000HP       |
O--------------O-------------------------------------O----------------O
| EXP: 762     | Battle Strategy: Another boss clone. This one takes  |
| GP: 0        | the form of Ice Golem, but made of stone. White works|
O--------------O good, so use that., so use that. Besides damaging him|
| Attack List  | alot, the first or second use of it, will wipe out   |
| ===========  | the two Cerberuses that are fighting with him. Just  |
| Axe Bomber   | don't use Flare, as he's strong against Fire, and    |
| Hypno Sleep  | you'll be fine.                                      |
| Ice Block    |                                                      |
| Mega Punch   |                                                      |
| Snow Storm   |                                                      |
| Stomp Stomp  |                                                      |
|              |                                                      |
O--------------O------------------------------------------------------O

After beating the Stone Golem, backtrack throughh the area, back to the
main stairway. The two metal blocks on the side will have dissapeared,
allowing you to continue going up. Enter the door on the next floor, to
reach the Fire portion of Doom Castle.

When you enter, head to the right, until you see some blocks in the lava
that you can jump to. Jump across them, and onto the next platform. Jump
to the ones on the left, reaching a platform with a Stheno on it, from
here. Kill the Stheno, and get some Cure Potions and Arrows from the
chests where she was. Jump down, to another platform, and kill the
Cerberus. Open the two chests - One contains Arrows, the other contains
Heal Potions - and grapple to the left. From here, jump straight ahead,
until reaching an Iflyte, which you should of course, kill. After you
defeat him, head left, and downward, and then to the right. Grapple to
the platform on your right, defeat the Stheno, and walk forward to 
greet the next Sub-boss, the Twinhead Wyvern!

               O-------------------------------------O
               |      Twinhead Wyvern - 15,000HP     |
O--------------O-------------------------------------O----------------O
| EXP: 600     | Battle Strategy: This is a clone of the Lava Dome    |
| GP: 0        | boss, the Dualhead Hydra. He fights with a Stheno,   |
O--------------O and an Ifylte, but they won't be too much trouble, if|
| Attack List  | you take them out from the get-go with Meteor from   |
| ===========  | Hero, and White from Phoebe. After the Stheno dies,  |
| Fire Breath  | switch to having them both use White. Keep this up,  |
| Para-breath  | until the enemies are all dead.                      |
| Poison Breath|                                                      |
| Scrunch      |                                                      |
| Stone Gas    |                                                      |
O--------------O------------------------------------------------------O

After killing the third sub-boss, again, head back to the main stairway.
Move up to the next floor, and go through the next door, into an area
that was made to look like Pazuzu's Tower. Be careful not to fall in 
this area, or you'll drop to the previous fire room, again!

Start, by going straight, until you reach the first fork. Take a right, 
and go down, through a door at the next juntion. Defeat the Cerberus, 
and go up the steps, to the higher platform. From here, head right, and
head straight along the path, until you reach a Chimera that you should
kill. Keep following the path, until you reach a Thanatos, blocking
some steps. Kill him, and head down the steps, and through the door.
Keep going straight, and kill the Cerberus, going through another door,
putting you behind a glass wall.

Head right, defeating the enemies behind the glass, until you reach 
another door. From here, head south, until you defeat a Chimera, and
go through another door. Don't go all the way through though! Go under
the doorway, and take aright. Stop at the middle doorway, and head
upwards. Take the stairs, and kill the Chimera. Head along this path,
to the left, until you reach another Chimera. Kill this one as well.
From here, it's a linear path to the center. Defeat one final Thanatos,
and get ready to take on Zuh.

               O-------------------------------------O
               |            Zuh  - 20,000HP          |
O--------------O-------------------------------------O----------------O
| EXP: 750     | Battle Strategy: This go is supposed to be a clone   |
| GP: 0        | of Pazuzu...But he actually has LESS HP. Oh well,    |
O--------------O you're going to kill him all the same. Use Flare     |
| Attack List  | every time it's Hero's turn, and have Phoeber use    |
| ===========  | White. Keep doing this, and in one or two rounds,    |
| Hurricane    | Zuh's buddies will go down, and after dealing down   |
| Piledriver   | some more pain, so will Zuh. Remember, be careful of |
| Psycheshield | his Psycheshield, attack, and you'll be fine.        |
| Sky Attack   |                                                      |
| Windstorm    |                                                      |
O--------------O------------------------------------------------------O

That was the last of the sub-bosses! Head back to the main stair way, 
and head to the top floor. Walk to the middle platform,and you'll place
the four crystals in the statue. Chests containing Arrows, Cure Potions,
Heal Potions, and Seeds will open. Stock and heal completely, and head 
through the door on the top side of the room. Go through the door, and
get read for the final battle...

               O-------------------------------------O
               |        Dark King  - 40,000HP        |
O--------------O-------------------------------------O----------------O
| EXP: 0       | Battle Strategy: First of all, before I go into the  |
| GP: 0        | real way to fight him, I'll tell you, you can use    |
O--------------O Cure on him to do 30,000+ damage! That really takes  | 
| Attack List  | the fun out of it though, so I hope you'll use the   |
| ===========  | following method instead: Have Hero use Flair, and   |
| Dark Sabre   | have Phoebe sue White. Also, since Flare should be   |
| Fire Sword   | doing more damage, have Phoebe be in charge if curing|
| Ice Sword    | and using seeds. Soon, he'll grow more arms, and get |
| Golden Web   | stronger, and have more defense. Keep hitting him the|
| Mirror Sword | same, though - and remember, healing is crucial. Most|
| Mega Flare   | of his attacks do 500+ damage per turn - Often to    |
| Mega White   | both characters. Heal as soon as/if someone dies, and|
| Quake Axe    | keep attacking. Soon, he'll transform again, into a  |
| Spark        | Spider. From here, watch out for Mega White and Mega |
| Spider Kids  | Flare, as they're both very strong. Soon his arms    |
| Super Stab   | will singe. Keep whacking away at his HP, and he'll  |
|              | finally die.                                         | 
O--------------O------------------------------------------------------O

After beating the Dark King, the mysterious cloaked man appears in 
front of you. I won't spoil the rest, but enjoy the ending, you've 
earned it.

          --- 1. Introduction ---                                      [1000]

Final Fantasy Mystic Quest is like the idiot's Final Fantasy. 

Even so, that doesn't make this game bad. Sure, a blindfolded monkey could 
beat it with one hand (exaggeration alert!), but that's not the point. It's a 
good game in general that differentiates from the "real" Final Fantasy. I 
like its style. Being a very "simple" RPG, it's a great game to play when I'm

          --- 2. FAQ ---                                               [2000]
~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~=~

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+

        [Q] What are battlefields?

        [A] Battlefields are places on the world map in which you can fight
            monsters. Beat 10 rounds of them, and you can win prizes or EXP
            and GP. 

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+

        [Q] How many battlefields are there?

        [A] There are 20 in all. You can check the walkthrough and seek out
            the one you're looking for. 

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+

        [Q] What exactly does "Auto" or "Manual" mean?

        [A] If you're talking about this game, "Auto" and "Manual" has either
            the computer control your ally or not. Auto will allow an ally to
            automatically attack while Manual forces you to make moves. 

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+

        [Q] How come my ally doesn't level up?

        [A] Your allies have a set level when they join your party and when
            they leave. I don't think it's possible to have them level up 
            without the use of a cheat device. 

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+

        [Q] How do I use Refreshers and what do they do?

        [A] Refreshers will regain any stats lost in-battle. For example, if
            a monster lowers your attack stats, then Refresher will regain 
            them. To use them, just select them from the "Item" bar.

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+

        [Q] I heard there was a really quick way of defeating the Dark King.
            How so?

        [A] Yeah, you can easily deal 30000 HP damage by just casting Cure on
            him. It's still cheap though. Besides, he's easy anyway. 8)

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
