              4.1. The Knight                                          [4100]
-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~--~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~

The first task is naming your character. Choose whatever suits your fancy. I
personally don't care what you decide to name him. I'll refer to him as
Benjamin for the most part. When you're finished, select the End option, 
orjust press the Start Button...

                         __________________________
                    ---=|      Hill Of Destiny     |=---
                         ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯    

An earthquake has driven Benjamin from his home up to the Hill Of Destiny 
(nice name). Coming across some random man, he demands to know what's going
on. The two will climb up to the top of the hill. A gap lies between Benjamin
and the man. Jump across with the B Button to get to the other side. The 
strange man will show you the Focus Tower, once the heart of the world. He'll
speak a bit about the situation at hand. 

[Insert Name Here], only you can save the Crystals and the World.

Obviously, Benjamin's a bit confused. Suddenly, a Behemoth will appear out of
nowhere. This is your first fight. Luckily, it's nothing too difficult. Since
regular attacks are really your only option at this point, just pound it with
that. It is possible to lose here, but you can always restart the battle. If
you manage to get a critical hit, you've basically killed the thing. 

The man will notice that the place is becoming dangerous (oh really?). Before
he flies away, he'll mention the Level Forest. Well, that's the only place
you can go...

__________________________
                    ---=|       Level Forest       |=---
                         ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯    

The man appears just as he promised. He'll tell you your first objective; save
the Crystal of Earth. And with that, he runs/flies off. That helped. You can
talk to the blue guy a bit to the north. That boulder is blocking his way.
He asks if you could shove it aside, but considering that he himself is kind 
of blocking your way, that might be a bit difficult. 

So what do you do? Use the B Button to jump over him. Simply push it up, and
he'll thank you. He will also tell you to bring the Tree Wither to Kaeli in
Foresta. Push the boulder up one more tile, and open the nearby chest for a 
few Cure Potions. Don't use them yet though. Walk east to leave the Level 
Forest. 

See the flashing arrow? Walk in the direction that its point to reach Foresta.
Let's deliver that Tree Wither to Kaeli now.

__________________________
                    ---=|         Foresta          |=---
                         ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯    

Houses here are made out of tree trunks. You can talk to some of the people
hanging around to learn some nifty information. An old lady will tell you that
the Crystal of Earth can be found to the north in the Bone Dungeon. Kaeli's
house was the first house you saw (when you entered Foresta). It's in the
lower-left corner of town. Enter her house and walk up to the two beds. Open
the chest for some more Cure Potions. Yeah, let's walk into more strangers'
houses and steal their drugs!

Talk to Kaeli and she'll mention a tree that is blocking the north exit of
the Level Forest. You agree to help out, and Kaeli decides to tag along. Her
mother gets a bit anxious though. But hey, who doesn't like some random 
stranger taking out their daughter? Before you joins, Kaeli picks up her axe. 
Obviously, she's a woman with attitude. 

Leave Kaeli's house and head north. At the northeast corner is a house. Inside
is that man you helped out. He'll allow you take the contents of the chest 
above him. However, the barrels are kind of blocking your way. Wow, what weird
people. Leave his house, and walk north over the wooden bridge. See the blocks 
of wood in the water? You can jump onto them. Use them to get to the back of 
his house and enter. Inside the chest is your first spell: Cure. It heals HP. 
Now move the barrels out of your way and leave his house. 

Before we skedaddle out of here, enter the house to your south. The bed on the
left will restore your HP. Don't forget to pick up the three Cure Potions in
the nearby chest. With that collected, you can finally leave Foresta. Head
west to return to the Level Forest. Yippee! 

As you re-enter the forest, Kaeli will appear and chop down some trees with 
her Axe. Of course, you're now obligated to fight a Brownie. You'll notice how
much more powerful Kaeli is than your main character. You have two ways to
go from this point. First, head left. Defeat the two Slimes and (soon) a 
Brownie. At the end of the path here are some more Cure Potions. Return to
the intersection and go right. See the red tree up ahead? Don't touch it just
yet. First, defeat the Slime and Brownie to the east. Pick up the Heal Potions
also. 

Heal up your team with Cure Potions. Examine the glowing tree and Kaeli will
cut it out of her way effortlessly. He'll poison Kaeli, but you two still put
up a fight. 

     Boss Fight: Minotaur ~
     =------------------=
          First, I'll tell you the cheap method of winning. Simply have Kaeli 
          cast Life on the Minotaur to immediately put him out of commission.
          If you'd rather just attack the conventional way though, you might
          have a tiny bit of trouble. Use Cure to heal up your units. The 
          Minotaur hits pretty hard, so you'll need it. Obviously, if Benjamin
          dies, you'll need Kaeli's Life spell to revive him. Just remember
          that. 

Once he's down for the count, Kaeli's mom, for some reason, appears. Kaeli
seems to be pretty confident in her survival. All she needs is Elixir... found
in the depths of the Sand Temple. Benjamin has to be a good boy, and says that
he will get it. Kaeli will hand you her Axe. Now you can chop down trees and
kick monster butt! 

Before continuing, check the southwest corner. You'll find a Brownie behind
some trees. Chop them down and fight it. Some Heal Potions can be found in the
chest behind it. If you'd like, you can exit and re-enter the Level Forest. 
The chests all respawn with the same items. It's not required, but it's always
a good idea to stock up on Cure Potions. When you're done fooling around, head
over to where you fought the Minotaur and continue onward.

-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~--~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~
              4.2. Dungeon Of Bones                                    [4200]
-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~--~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~

Simply go north, and you'll reach your first battlefield. Since you'll probably
die without the help of another member, bypass it. Continue north to reach 
the Sand Temple. 

                         __________________________
                    ---=|       Sand Temple        |=---
                         ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

Simply walk up until you find a chest. Open it to find the Elixir... gone? A
dude will walk in. Apparently, he got here before you did. He'll offer to sell
it to you for 9000 GP. Deal!! You probably don't have that much money at the
moment. Anyhow, Tristam will offer another, more reasonable deal. Get him 
through the Bone Dungeon. Help him find the treasure and you get the Elixir.
It's as simple as that. 

Tristam mentioned Battlefields right? You have two that are accessible at the
moment. There's one to the south (the one that you passed), and one to the 
west. Basically, Battlefields pits you up against monsters in 10 rounds. Beat 
them all for EXP, GP and items. Start with the one just south of your current 
position. If you ever need healing, head back to Foresta to heal up. 

     Battlefield One ~
     =-------------=
          Monsters: Mad Plant, Poison Toad
          Prize: 54 EXP
           ~ Pretty simple here. Tristam kicks incredible amounts of butt with
             his shurikens. I managed to breeze through all 10 rounds without
             even breaking a sweat. Benjamin and Tristam should be able to
             kill each monster within one hit. Mad Plants are weak against
             Axes, so Benjamin should really win out. Trust me, it's THAT 
             easy. If you managed to get poisoned, return to Foresta and use
             the bed to heal up. Heal Potions work too. 

     Battlefield Two ~
     =-------------=
          Monsters: Mad Plant, Poison Toad, Basilisk
          Prize: Charm
           ~ This one is a tad bit harder than the above, but that's only
             because of the Basilisks. Also, a lot of the battles put you up
             against three monsters and not just two. Sure, it's a step up,
             but nothing you can't handle. Have Benjamin kill off the Mad
             Plants while Tristam takes care of the rest. If you managed to 
             get poisoned, return to Foresta and use the bed to heal up. Heal
             Potions work too. 

Once you finish both Battlefields, return to Foresta for healing and whatnot.
Take advantage of the re-appearing chests in the Level Forest as well. When 
you're done, proceed to the Bone Dungeon, of which is north of the Sand 
Temple.

__________________________
                    ---=|      Bone Dungeon        |=---
                         ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

See the moving sand just ahead of you? Step onto it and you'll be carried to
a chest. Open it for some Cure Potions. Now, fight the monsters on either
side to get past them. I would suggest fighting them all for the experience.
They're not difficult either. The monsters here consists mostly of those you
already fought in the Battlefields. Anyway, the skull thingy is the door to
the next room. However, there are more items here to pick up.

Will you go left or right? Go left first because... that path's kind of what
I'll describe right now. Beat up the Sand Worm in your way along with the 
other monsters here. A Sand Worm guards the chest in the northwest corner. It
contains 10 Ninja Stars for Tristam. Now, if you head over to the right side
of the room, you can find another 10 Ninja Stars directly opposite the last
chest. Pick that up and go through the skull doorway. 

Walk up a bit to be stopped by some water. Luckily, some stones are in the 
perfect position for you to jump over them. Use them (jump to them) to get to
the other side. See the steps to your right? Have Benjamin go into the water.
Now, if he could just walk on water like (???), what was the point of using
those stones? Anyway, trudge over to the west side of the water to find a 
skeleton with an abnormally large rib-cage. 

Follow the skeleton until you reach open water again. Walk up the nearby steps
to find a door. Tristam will appear and blow the crap out of the door for you.
Afterwards, he tries to sell you some bombs for 30G. Decline the first time,
and he'll cut the price in half. 15G is the lowest you can get them at. Before
continuing, return through the skeleton back to the first part of this room.
Walk back up the steps onto dry land. A bit to your north is a skull. Blow it
out of the way with your newly acquired bomb. Past it is a Steel Shield. 
Return to the door that Tristam blew up for you and continue. 

Uh oh, more monsters. Boy, this room is loaded. Beat up the various Rocs, 
Skeletons, and Sand Worms. First, blow up the cracked door at the upper-right
corner. In the chest is another 10 Ninja Stars for Tristam. Head over to the
northeast corner and continue onwards. The staircase there will bring you down
to B2. From the staircase, head east. Defeat the Gorgon that is blocking the
chest. Inside is 10 Bombs. 

To your north is a Skeleton. Beat it up. Continue up to find a rather long
skeleton. Place a bomb at the weak part of the skeleton to blow up the entire
thing. First, head right to find a secret doorway leading to a chamber with
a chest. Use the stones to hop across the water. The chest contains 10 Ninja
Stars. Return to the shattered rib-cage (poor thing) and advance west. Walk
through the skeletal head. 

To your south are two monsters. You only need to defeat one to reach the chest 
at the south end. It contains another 10 Ninja Stars for Tristam. Geez, this 
game doesn't have much faith in you, does it? Head north to find some moving 
sand. The only part that you can cross is lined with monsters. Defeat them all 
and make your way to the other side. Don't step on the moving sand, or else
you'll go back. Instead, blow a hole in the weak part of the nearby skeleton
with a bomb. 

Kill the Minotaur Zombie that is blocking your path. Now, move south. Don't
step on the moving sand unless you want to be carried back. See the staircase?
Descend them to B2. Shove the Skeleton out of the way. To your immediate left
is a Minotaur Zombie guarding a chest containing 10 Ninja Stars. Return back
and look up. The skeletal head has its mouth closed. Of course, a little bomb
can easily blow it back up. Do just that and continue.

You'll reach a fork while still in the rib-cage. Don't go left just yet. 
Instead, go north through the doorway. Take the three Seeds and return to
the split. Go left to find some more moving sand. The only safe passage is
lined with monsters. Clear the pathway and check the next skeleton. The mouth
is closed once more. Repeat what you did a few minutes ago to open it. Once
more, you'll reach a fork. Go up first. The Quake spell can be found in here.
You don't want to miss out.

Back at the fork, head right. Get the Minotaur Zombie out of the way and
advance. Once again, place a bomb on the skull to open up a passage. Enter the
next room. Before continuing, heal up a bit. A difficult monster is just up
ahead. See the big, red thingy? Yeah, that's it. Jump across the water (using
the stone) to face it. *battle cry*

     Boss Fight: Flamerus Rex ~
     =----------------------=
          You know, they could have at least come up with a better name. 
          Assuming you didn't already use up all your Quakes, now would be a
          great time for Benjamin to use them. The Flamerus Rex can deal 100+
          damage with most of his attacks, so make sure that Benjamin or 
          Tristam heals up occasionally. Both Life and Cure heal HP so use
          them. Because the Flamerus Rex is strong against poison, don't count
          on Tristam dealing too much damage. Have him heal and revive Benjamin
          with Life if need be. When the boss's HP gets pretty low, he can use
          Rip Earth, which deals a good amount of damage to both of them. Like
          always, heal when your HP gets too low. Have Benjamin use Quake until
          he runs out. Then throw some bombs to finish the Flamerus Rex off.

Once the freak is defeated, Tristam will immediately run to get his treasure.
A crystal rises from the corpse of the Flamerus Rex. You have already fulfilled
your first objective; to release the first crystal. Tristam will play around
with a weapon reminiscent of the Hookshot in Zelda games. He'll also give you
the Elixir he promised. For some reason, Tristam didn't take _all_ of the 
treasures. Be sure to open the last three for some Cure Potions, more 
Explosives, and the Sand Coin. Do not forget the last item!!

You will want to return to Foresta now to give Kaeli the Elixir. As you exit
the Bone Dungeon, Tristam will leave you. 

-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~--~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~
              4.3. Wakewater!                                          [4300]
-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~--~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~

By releasing the last crystal, Foresta has been restored. The grass is green
again and people are young. Head over to Kaeli's house to give her the Elixir.
For such a terminally ill person, she doesn't seem very sick... Kaeli will 
state that she will head off to Aquaria to see Spencer. Why don't we get over
there first? If you need to heal, go ahead to the house at the southeast 
corner. Sleep in the bed. 

To reach Aquaria, you'll have to go through the Focus Tower. First, head east
from the Sand Temple. You'll hit a Battlefield. If you want to fight here, go
ahead. 

     Battlefield Three ~
     =---------------=
          Monsters: Basilisk, Sand Worm, Minotaur Zombie
          Prize: 150 GP
           ~ If you chose to fight here by yourself, you might have some
             trouble. Even so, the monsters are nothing new as you've already
             battled them in the Bone Dungeon. Minotaur Zombies are the more
             dangerous foe here. They can confuse, paralyze, and blind you. It 
             really sucks when Benjamin (out of confusion) happens to cast 
             Quake on himself only to die instantly. If you can keep those
             status ailments off your back, this Battlefield should be easy.

You will find the Focus Tower west of the Battlefield. The smart thing to do
here would would be to enter. 

                         __________________________
                    ---=|  Focus Tower to Aquaria  |=---
                         ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

Simply follow the path until you reach the strange man. Yes, he's here waiting
for you. He'll mention Captain Mac and a girl named Phoebe. Suddenly, the
freak flies off again without clarifying what the hell he just said. Nice...

Going any further south leads to nothing. Just enter the nearby opening. Pick
up the 10 bombs and check the gold seal on the wall. Because you have the Sand
Coin, you can open it. The other seals cannot be opened because you (duh!) do
not have the Coin for their respective doors. The path will lead you to a 
staircase. Ascend them to 2F. Turn to your left and head south to reach a 
chest. Yay, you've just picked up your second Black Magic spell.  

Although there appears to be a bunch of other staircases around and such, those
are not accessible at the moment. Return to the stairs that you took up here
and go through the doorway. You will appear back outside, but in a different
part of the world. Continue east and reach another Battlefield. If you want to
wait until you get another member in your team, skip it. If you want to fight
RIGHT NOW (!!), just do it. 

     Battlefield Four ~
     =--------------=
          Monsters: Mintmint
          Prize: 99 EXP
           ~ Mintmints will be the only monster encountered here. They aren't 
             terrifyingly tough, but they can deal some good damage. I can 
             tell you that they're less annoying than those crazy Minotaur 
             Zombies from the last Battlefield. For such easy monsters, they 
             sure give quite a bit of EXP. Quake works well along with some 
             bombs. 

North of the Battlefield is the Libra Temple. Enter.

__________________________
                    ---=|       Libra Temple       |=---
                         ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

Up ahead is a white tile with an omega symbol on it. Ignore it at the moment.
Above it is a chest and a girl standing next to it. Take some Explosives from
the chest and talk to the other. You'll learn some depressing news. It seems
that Aquaria is now frozen, the people are sick, and to top it all off,
her grandpa is trapped! Benjamin will ask her about Spencer. It seems that HE
is her grandpa! As Phoebe tries to leave, Benjamin kidnaps her. You now have a 
new member who is actually GOOD with magic. 

Leave the Libra Temple and head east to find two consecutive Battlefields in a
row! 

     Battlefield Five ~
     =--------------=
          Monsters: Giant Toad, Mintmint
          Prize: 300 GP
           ~ I hate Giant Toads with a passion. They can poison and paralyze
             you effortlessly. Phoebe has the Heal spell which cures status 
             ailments though. Giant Toads also give a lot of EXP -- always a
             good thing. Simply have Phoebe cast Thunder or Fire while 
             Benjamin just attacks. When you need to heal up, check in at the 
             inn at Aquaria. 

     Battlefield Six ~
     =-------------=
          Monsters: Giant Toad, Mintmint, Scorpion
          Prize: Magic Ring
           ~ Giant Toads and Mintmints galore. Plus a new monster; the 
             Scorpion. Fire magic is your best friend here. Luckily, both
             Benjamin and Phoebe should have it. Scorpions are weak against
             Fire, so those are easily vanquished. If you're poisoned or
             paralyzed, use Phoebe's Heal spell to get rid of those. 

Past those two Battlefields is the town that we were originally looking for;
Aquaria! Enter the now-frozen town.

__________________________
                    ---=|         Aquaria          |=---
                         ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

The inn up ahead can restore your HP and stuff. However, you'll have to pay a
hefty fee of 95 GP. Ouch. Also at the inn is a girl who will sell you some
Explosives. Only buy some if you're low. West of the inn is Phoebe's house. 
Phoebe will explain a little bit more about Spencer's predicament. To melt the
ice here, you'll need Wakewater from the Libra Temple. However, we'll need the
Libra Crest first. 

If you'd like, you can steal some Heal Potions from Phoebe's house. Before 
heading out, check the house behind Phoebe's. The woman will sell you a Steel
Helmet for 200 GP. Trust me, you want this. Don't forget to pick up the 
Refreshers by the beds. There's nothing interesting in her basement. Leave
Aquaria and head further west to hit yet another Battlefield!

     Battlefield Seven ~
     =---------------=
          Monsters: Edgehog, Scorpion, Giant Toad
          Prize: 99 EXP
           ~ Edgehog is the new monster in this Battlefield. Like the Scorpion,
             Edgehogs are weak against the Fire spell. They pack quite a 
             punch, so watch out for them. If you're poisoned by the Giant
             Toads, use Phoebe's Heal spell. It beats having to pay 95 GP for
             the inn back in Aquaria. This should be an easy-peasy Battlefield.

North of that Battlefield is the Wintry Cave. Here, we should find the Libra
Crest so we can actually enter the Libra Temple.

__________________________
                    ---=|       Wintry Cave        |=---
                         ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

At the start, you have two ways to go. Head left first and beat up the 
monsters in your way. The chest contains 10 bombs. Return to the split and
head in the opposite direction. Clear the Scorpion out of your way. Follow the
path and trudge up the steps. Meet the Edgehog at the top. Continue along, 
clearing out the Land Worms in your way. 

The floor will collapse and Benjamin tumbles down. Phoebe saves only herself. 
She'll let you use her Cat Claws. With them, you can climb walls, but only if
they have steps. Let's put it to use. A little bit to your right is a climb-
able wall. Pick up the Heal Potions. Keep on climbing up. As long as you hold
the A Button, you can't fall. Move yourself so that you can climb to the upper
ledge -- the one that you just fell from. Now back up here, continue west. 

A Centaur blocks your path here. Be careful of them as Centaurs can confuse
you. Inspect the wall behind where he once stood. At one point is a cracked
wall. Yeah, you guessed it. Bomb time!! Blow it up and continue. There are a 
bunch of monsters here. If you want the Cure Potions and Arrows, beat them all
to clear a path to the chests. If you don't, beat them up anyway for the EXP.
After getting the Arrows, climb down the shiny wall. Walk around to the other
side of the room so you can access the Cure Potions. 

When you're done with that, leave the room. Continue east to find two monsters
guarding a chest. Take three more Cure Potions from the chest. Now, head back
west and climb the wall. Position yourself so that you are along the other 
wall. Let go of the A Button to fall onto a separate platform. Kill off the
Edgehog and keep going. After getting rid of another Land Worm, the path will
begin to widen up a bit. 

Keep going south to find a chest. Get the Centaur out of the way first. Three
Refreshers can be found inside. Head northwest from there to find a Scorpion
blocking a wall. Getting boring, eh? Climb the wall behind its corpse. Move
one or two spaces to the left and drop down. Defeat the Edgehog a little bit
up ahead. Climb the nearby wall to the next platform. A Scorpion guards the
wall here. Once it's gone, climb the wall behind it. 

Well, what do you know? Another monster! Clear the Edgehog out of the way to 
reveal a cracked door. Place a bomb and blow it to smithereens. Inside is 
another batch of monsters. There are some items here. The two chests you see
at the entrance three Cure Potions and 10 Arrows. Fight your way north along
the path. Obviously, this is going to take a while. In the next open section
of this room, you can go northeast to advance or southeast to find two more
chests. Snag the Heal Potions and Arrows. Proceed to the northeast portion of
this room to find the staircase leading OUTTA here. 

Before you can fight the boss, you'll have to vanquish the monsters below him.
The sheet of ice above you makes it kind of hard to see. Clear a way to the
center platform, of which the boss stands upon. The chest nearby contains 
Arrows. If you'd like, you can defeat all the monsters for EXP. However, I 
don't really see a point to doing all of that work. Anyway, the boss awaits
your company. Heal up before you fight! 

     Boss Fight: Squidite ~
     =------------------=
          Yeah, it's a gigantic squid. Got a problem with that? Squidite 
          starts the battle with two Sparna allies. Phoebe can easily shoot
          them down with her Bow of Grace. Once those are taken care of, you
          can focus on Squidite itself. Use Phoebe's Thunder spell to take
          advantage of Squidite's weakness to that element. However, don't
          think it's just going to sit there. Squidite can deal some heavy
          damage as well as inflict certain status ailments upon your units.
          Needless to say, if Phoebe needs to use Heal, USE IT! Once Phoebe
          runs out of Thunder, just start pounding it with physical attacks
          to bring it down.

Defeating the Squidite will reveal a chest. Open it for the Libra Crest. With
it, you can warp to the Life Temple from the Libra Temple. Backtrack all the
way out of this dungeon. Return to Aquaria for some healing. From the Wintry 
Cave, head west to find another Battlefield. 
 
     Battlefield Eight ~
     =---------------=
          Monsters: Desert Hag
          Prize: 600 GP
           ~ The problem with Desert Hags is their counter-attack. If you use
             a physical attack (that doesn't kill in one hit), you'll most 
             likely eat a nasty counter-attack. Desert Hags can deal quite a 
             bit of damage if you don't defeat them quickly. Fire magic is 
             your best bet here. Desert Hags are weak against that. 

I assume that you remember where the Libra Temple is. Head back over there. 
Now that you have the Libra Crest, stepping on the omega tile will bring you
to the Life Temple.

__________________________
                    ---=|       Life Temple        |=---
                         ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

Oh noes! The water has dried up. That sucks. There is someone else here who
might be able to help though. Walk north through the opening. It's that strange
man that's been terrorizing you since forever! Luckily, he managed to save 
what was left of the Wakewater in a tiny bag. He'll fly off like always. Don't
forget to pick up the Cure Potions. When ready, return to Aquaria. 

Phoebe will use the Wakewater on the plant at the center of town. The plant
unfreezes... but everything else stays frozen (???). To unfreeze the rest of
town, you need to release the next crystal. Since there's not much left to do
here in Aquaria, head north to reach the Falls Basin. Before you can reach the
Ice Pyramid, you'll need to traverse through the Falls Basin.

__________________________
                    ---=|        Falls Basin       |=---
                         ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

Phoebe will appear and tell you push the block. Move the ice block nine spaces 
up, seven spaces to the left, and one space up. Once you finish that task, it 
should be in-between the two platforms. If you were to jump from one to the 
ice block, you would be able to get across. For now, just go through the 
opening up ahead. 

Defeat the Desert Hag to clear the way. Walk to the other end of this small
room to find another opening. Use the ice block you pushed before. Jump onto
it. From there, jump to the opposite platform. Continue south and beat up 
another Desert Hag. I wonder what a _Desert_ Hag is doing here. Walk down
the tiny steps and fight the Lamia to reveal another ice block. Ready for some
more shoving around?

Push the ice block four spaces to the right and one space up. Like before, 
this block should act as a stepping stone between the two platforms. Head back
west and walk up the tiny steps. Head east and use the ice block to get 
across the gap. Keep going east and fight the Lamia. With this block, move it
four spaces to the left, one space up, two more spaces to the left, six
spaces up, and ten spaces right. 

Take the other ice block at the south end of the screen. Push it four spaces
up, eight spaces to the right, one space down, and three spaces to the right.
Have it rest right below the last ice block. Re-locate the third ice block.
Push it one square to the right, one square down, eight squares right, one
square up, three more squares to the right, and one square up. Phew!

Walk over to the southeastern corner of this chamber. Use the stairs and 
head north. Hop over the gap and onto the two ice blocks you put into place.
Kill off the Desert Hag and continue. Open the chest for some more bombs. 
Defeat the nearby Lamia and follow the path. You'll come to the point where
you placed the third ice block. Hop over the gap onto the block. The boss is
up ahead but before fighting it, snag the Heal spell from the chest nearby. 
Replenish your HP and battle the giant crap... I mean crab. 

     Boss Fight: Snow Crab ~
     =-------------------=
          The Snow Crap has two Desert Hags to help him out. Have Benjamin
          and Phoebe use Fire to take them down quickly. The Snow Crab has 
          some tough attacks. He can easily deal 200+ damage, so make sure
          that you heal when necessary. Thunder works the best in this battle.
          Have Phoebe cast that while Benjamin either heals or uses Quake. 
          When the Snow Crab's HP is low, he'll begin to use Tornado for very 
          heavy damage. Heal whenever necessary, and you should be fine. 
          Mmm, seafood! 

Head up to the cracked door and Phoebe will appear to tell you about Jumbo
Bombs. These upgraded explosives deal more damage to enemies while still 
blowing up cracked doors and the like. Use it on the wall just ahead of you.
Now that you're back outside, return to Aquaria for some healing. When you're
done with that, walk past the Falls Basin to yet another Battlefield. 

     Battlefield Nine ~
     =--------------=
          Monsters: Lamia, Desert Hag, Mage
          Prize: 540 EXP
           ~ Desert Hags have counter-attacks that you should already be 
             familiar with. Just blast them with a Fire spell or kill them
             with a physical attack. Your choice. Lamias on the other hand,
             can put a unit to sleep or confuse them. Have your Heal spell 
             handy for that. Use Thunder to take them down quickly. The Mages
             that you fight are capable of casting various spells including 
             Blizzard and Cure. Blizzard is their main attack spell. When 
             their HP is low though, they will cast Cure to heal themselves.

And just ahead of that Battlefield is (surprise, surprise) the Ice Pyramid!
Make sure that your team is refreshed and fully healed before attempting to 
take it on. 

                         __________________________
                    ---=|       Ice Pyramid        |=---
                         ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

A wall blocks any further progress. Check the oddly-colored statue on the 
right. Take your Steel Sword and poke the switch to open the wall. Continue
into the main room. Begin by head east first. Follow the path until you reach
a fork. Continue east to the lower-left corner of this chamber. Walk a little
bit north. You have two ways to go, left or right? The path on the right is 
the way to go. Do not be surprised if a battle suddenly begins. Monsters here 
are invisible at the moment.

At the end of this path is a chest containing a Magic Mirror. With it, you 
can see the invisible enemies here! Backtrack to the split. Take the path on
the left this time. Defeat the Desert Hags and take the Explosives from the
chest. Return to the pyramid's entrance. Go southwest and open the two chests
for some Refreshers an Arrows. Avert your gaze to the other two paths. Not
counting the one you took to reach these chests, take the path on the right. 

Slay the Desert Hag and proceed. A Mage blocks a staircase up ahead. On the
next floor, head a little bit north to find some Heal Potions guarded by a 
Phanquid. With that in your pack, head back downstairs. Now back at the two 
empty chests, take the left path. After a bit of walking, a Lamia will appear.
From here, you have three possible paths to take; northeast, southeast, and
northwest. Whee, I love choices!

Take the southeast path first. Get the monster out of the way and continue. 
Defeat another Mage blocking the staircase. Ascend the steps to the next 
floor. Dead end? Defeat the Lamia and walk into the wall that she was 
originally in front of. It seems that you can walk into the wall here. Steal
the Arrows in the chest and return to the three-way fork. 

Now, head to the northeast fork. A Desert Hag blocks the way, so defeat it. 
Keep going east past another monster. Advance until you hit another set
of stairs blocked by a Mage... again. You know the drill. Kick him out of your
way. On the next floor, head south to find a blue-tinged statue. It's pretty
obvious that it's really a switch. Use your Steel Sword to hit it. The wall
will open up to reveal a chest containing some arrows. 

Look a little bit to your left. Another Lamia blocks the path here. Keep 
walking and defeat any unlucky monsters that happen to cross your path. At the
end, you'll reach another staircase. This one leads to 3F. Begin here by 
moving right first. What do you know? MORE monsters! Stoney Roosts, Gathers,
and Freezer Crabs are some new faces you might see. A Freezer Crab guards a 
chest containing more Arrows. By now, you're probably running low on those. 

Further south is another chest with some more Arrows. Jump over that chest to
keep going. Take care of another Gather and continue along. At the end is a 
suspicious statue -- poke it! The wall to your left will rise revealing a 
path. Backtrack to the entrance stairs and head west. Take care of the monster
blocking your path. All you have to do now is follow the path. But as always, 
enemies will get in your way. This is really getting annoying, isn't it?

When you reach the south end of this room, you should see an opening on the
wall. Walk through to immediately be pushed into a battle with some Stoney
Roosts. These birds are annoying as they can petrify you on a whim. After 
clipping their wings, you can find some bombs and Arrows ahead. Exit this area
and keep going east. Soon enough, you will reach the area where you had to
hit the switch to raise the wall. Turn left and head through the doorway. 
Ta-da, stairs!

Now on 4F, begin by heading left. After killing the Mage, you'll have to walk
around to the southeastern corner where a staircase is located. A Sphinx 
guards it, so make sure to take care of that. Head up the stairs and walk
forward so that you FALL off the floor. You will find yourself in the middle
of 4F. Now that you're surrounded by chests and monsters, why not have some
fun? There are multiple chests here. If you choose to open them all, you'll
find 40 Arrows, 3 Refreshers, 3 Heal Potions, 3 Cure Potions, and the Noble
Armor. DO NOT FORGET THE LAST ITEM!! The monsters around also give a helluva
lot of EXP. 

To continue, you need to locate the statue. It's at the northwest corner of
this area. Hit it with your Steel Sword to open a door on the opposite side.
Retrace your steps to the southeast corner. Return to 5F, but don't fall this
time. Begin by heading left. After getting rid of the monster, you can access
the two chests. To get the second one, you'll need to jump over the first. 
They both contain bombs. Kill the Stoney Roost and continue north. Defeat the
Gather. You have two ways to go from here. 

Begin by heading north. Kill off the Freezer Crab and walk past it. Carefully
walk to the other end and pick up the bombs. Return to the middle platform and
head left. The only way to reach that chest at the opposite end is by jumping.
Keep in mind that the darker blue line IS NOT a path. It's a wall. Therefore,
you'll have to walk north and jump at the chest from behind it. Open it for
some Cure Potions. 

Go back to the middle platform once more. See the cracked tile in the middle?
Place a bomb on top of it to blow a hole in the platform. This should be fun.
Fall down and KEEP falling down until you reach 1F. When you do, stop! Above
you are six statues. Poke any one of them to open up the floor. Now resume
your falling. When you hit B1, you will find yourself in an uncomfortable
situation. Haha, surrounded by enemies? Whether or not you choose to clear
them all out or not, don't forget about the chests. Snag some more Arrows,
Heal Potions, and Cure Potions. Also, remember to pick up the Knight Sword. 
Whoo!

Climb the platform above you with the Cat Claws to find a very ugly creature.
Apparently, he's enjoying your little game. Head over to the southeast corner.
Locate the staircase and use it to get "under" the ice sheet. Go northwest to
find a Lamia guarding a doorway. Defeat it and head through the opening. Oh
dear, more monsters! You don't have to beat them all though. Just clear out
the one standing in front of the wall. Use the Cat Claws to climb it. Waiting
for you at the top is a Sphinx. Slay it and keep walking. 

Simply go straight until you reach a doorway. If you hit the statue on the
right, you can reveal two chests. However, you'll have to drop off all the 
way to 5F to get it. If you really need it, then get them. If not, ignore them
for later. Heal up, and head through the opening. Follow the icy path to the
Ice Golem. Bwahaha!

     Boss Fight: Ice Golem ~
     =-------------------=
          Oh no; a giant made of ice! So scary. The key to this fight is Fire
          magic. Luckily, both Benjamin and Phoebe should have that spell 
          available. Simply roast the Ice Golem with some of that. Be wary of
          his attacks though. They can deal a considerable bit of damage to
          your units. When necessary have either of your units heal. There's
          only one of him, so the Ice Golem can easily be overpowered. When
          your Black Magic runs dry, start pounding him with physical attacks.
          Keep your team healed up and you should be fine.

Once the Ice Golem is melted, another crystal will appear. That's two for 
four. At least now, half of the world is peaceful once more. Aquaria should 
also be fixed. Phoebe will leave to check it out. Before you call it quits, 
pick up the River Coin from the chest. You don't want to forget that. Make 
your way out of here. 

You should immediately notice how green everything looks. Gone is the snow 
that once had this region covered. Make your way back to Aquaria. 

-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~--~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~
              4.4. Burning Hot                                         [4400]
-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~--~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~-~

Check it out. Aquaria is no longer frozen. First, head over to Phoebe's pad
and talk to her. She'll thank you for your help, and tell you that Spencer is
in the tunnel under her house. Use the steps right in front of the inn. Your
magical ability to walk on water (???) should help out here. Walk over toward
Phoebe's house and head underneath.

__________________________
                    ---=|     Spencer's Place      |=---
                         ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

Phoebe's gramps sure has a big place here. At the start of the tunnel, use
the steps to climb back onto dry land. Proceed south across a bridge and down
a long staircase. Cross some more bridges and should eventually reach the 
foot of the waterfall. Go through the opening into the next area. Ignore the
first bridge leading west for now. The other bridge leads to Spencer. As you
can see, he just realized that the ice had melted. After a bit of surprising
news, Spencer will hand you the Venus Key. With it, you can pick up this 
supposed shield that was located by Captain Mac. 

North of Spencer is a doorway. Follow it to the other side of the wall. You
can climb the nearby wall with the Cat Claws. Drop down to the chest and pick
up some Cure Potions. That's basically it for here. Make your way out of this
cave. 

Our next destination is the Focus Tower. However, you could make a stop at the
inn. An old guy will offer to sell some Cure Potions for 25 GP each. The other
dude still sells Explosives at the same price as always. Head over to the
Libra Temple and go north. There are two Battlefields here. Battle here now
or later. They're not going to disappear or anything. 

     Battlefield Ten ~
     =-------------=
          Monsters: Phanquid, Sphinx
          Prize: Exit Spell
           ~ This Battlefield should be a cakewalk with your newfound Knight
             Sword. Monsters usually don't come in groups here (two at most), 
             so you should have no problem ripping away. The Sphinx is the
             more dangerous opponent. Be sure to take them down first. Riddle
             can easily confuse your unit. Phanquids can also blind you, so 
             be wary of that too. 

     Battlefield Eleven ~
     =----------------=
          Monsters: Gather, Freezer Crab
          Prize: 744 EXP
           ~ The Gathers are very easy to defeat. Freezer Crabs, on the other
             hand, might take a few hits to put down. Jumbo Bombs work great
             against Gathers as they're weak to them. For Freezer Crabs, just
             hack away with your Knightsword. Be careful of counter-attacks
             from these crustaceans as well. Just hope they don't deal too
             much damage before going down. 

Past those two is the Wintry Temple. Entering will just bring you to a dead
end. Ignore it for now and keep going. The Focus Tower is up ahead.

__________________________
                    ---=|  Focus Tower to Fireburg |=---
                         ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

You begin on 3F with a staircase right in front of you. A familiar person will
greet you downstairs. "Some awful news made Captain Mac race from his home."
Your objective now is to seek Reuben who can be found in Fireburg. Just before
he proceeds with his daily "fly away" routine, he'll mention a statue. 

Now you're by yourself again. Bomb the wall to your immediate left to make an
opening. Walk through this passage to a chest containing the shield that 
Spencer was talking about. Equip your Venus Shield with pride and return to
the stairs. If you head over to the other side of the room, you will locate a 
Blizzard spell in a chest. Return to the statue that the man mentioned and
get ready to move it. Where, you ask? Push it two squares to the left. Now
move it down until it hits the south wall and left until it's stopped by a
stone thingy. 

Leave the Focus Tower and circle around it so that you reach it through its
OTHER entrance. Enter once more. Walk through the opened door to the set of
four colored doors. With the River Coin, you can unlock the blue door. Do
just that and continue up the next set of stairs. Head down and jump the gap
using the statue you moved previously. Turn west and follow the path to a 
staircase. 

Use your brain and climb up. Pick up the Cure Potions from the chest to the
south. The exit is just due north of the chest. You'll appear in a different
portion of the world. Walk to the next area and the ground will shake. Damn.
Well, you just hit a row of Battlefields, so why not battle?

     Battlefield Twelve ~
     =----------------=
          Monsters: Jelly
          Prize: 900 GP
           ~ Okay, this is simple. Unless you're out of Explosives, 10 rounds
             should go by easily if you know what to do. Jellies are extremely
             weak to Jumbo Bombs. Simply throw one at them. There you go,
             mission accomplished. 

     Battlefield Thirteen ~
     =------------------=
          Monsters: Jelly, Sting Rat
          Prize: Gemini Crest
           ~ Sting Rats have a weakness. That weakness is Blizzard. If you'd 
             prefer to conserve your black magic though, just cut them up
             with your Knight Sword. Sting Rats can get pretty annoying with
             their Poison Sting attacks and such. But assuming that you can
             kill them before they have a chance to attack, you should be 
             fine. Jellies are vulnerable to Jumbo Bombs. Plain and simple.
             If you need to, stop at Fireburg to heal up. 

     Battlefield Fourteen ~
     =------------------=
          Monsters: Plant Man
          Prize: 816 EXP
           ~ Swap that Knight Sword for an Axe when fighting. Plant Mans are
             weak against Axes. These ugly trees can inflict various status
             ailments upon your unit with Bad Breath. Obviously, have Heal
             ready just in case you need to relieve an ailment. Just chop down

Fireburg is just ahead in case you didn't know that. Well, you might have
already been here to heal up... or not.

__________________________
                    ---=|          Fireburg        |=---
                         ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

Fireburg doesn't have an inn. Oh no. Fireburg has a HOTEL which is infinitely
cooler than any old inn. Apparently, the hotel currently has a live rock
show (just look at all those posters), which is strange to see in a Final 
Fantasy game...

Anyway, you can stay for 95 GP. Now, we have to find Reuben. The old guy 
outside the hotel will sell you Explosive (damn pyromaniac). See the house to
the left of the hotel? That's Reuben's house. Talk to the guy in armor and
he'll tell you his predicament. He has to help his dad from behind a boulder.
Benjamin agrees to help, so Reuben joins. 

Don't forget to get the Refreshers from the chest before heading on out. Climb
down the wall in front of the hotel (Cat Claws) to reach the locked house. 
Since it's locked, there's nothing much we can do. Return to the hotel and
look for Tristam. He's over by the bar. Tristam hands you the Multi-Key which
opens locks. Before you barge into the guy's house, you can listen to the band
(for no reason), buy Cure Potions, or buy some Seeds. 

Go check out the locked house. With the Multi-Key, you can open the door. Talk
to the man and he'll mention Arion and the gigantic boulder. He'll also teach
you how to use a Mega Grenade. Just throw it. You can try it out a bit. Before
heading out, go to the house in lower-left corner of town. A woman will sell
you a Battle Axe for 500 GP. You will definitely want this. If you check out
her basement, you'll find a strange tile. Stepping on it will warp to a house
in Aquaria. This is great if you don't feel like walking all the way back.

Leave Fireburg and head west. Two more Battlefields are up ahead. With your
newfound Mega Grenades and Battle Axe, why don't you kick some monster butt?

     Battlefield Fifteen ~
     =-----------------=
          Monsters: Sting Rat, Flazzard, Plant Man
          Prize: 1200 GP
           ~ Plant Men are weak against the Battle Axe (And Reuben's Morning
             Star). Sting Rats can be obliterated with Blizzard. Flazzards are
             probably a new monster to you. They're weak to Blizzard as well.
             Be careful of the Sting Rat's Poison Sting. Reuben's only spell
             is Life, so you'll have to rely on Benjamin's Heal spell to take
             care of that. 

     Battlefield Sixteen ~
     =-----------------=
          Monsters: Flazzard, Red Cap
          Prize: Thunder Spell
           ~ When up against Flazzards, simply cast Blizzard. Reuben should be
             able to take each monster out within one hit. Benjamin, on the
             other hand, should be a bit weaker. Don't hesitate to use magic 
             often. Red Caps are easy to beat too, but they can use Stare to
             confuse your units or Hypno-sleep to put someone to sleep. 

Walk past those two Battlefields to reach the Mine. Reuben's dad is trapped
somewhere here...

__________________________
                    ---=|           Mine           |=---
                         ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

This area is a bit confusing. You'll find conveyor belts along with pulley
systems. Note that if you go in one direction on one of these, you cannot go
back without finding the alternative route to return. 

You have three ways to go from the start. The conveyor belt to your east is
not accessible because it's moving toward you. Head north first and fight a 
Red Bone. Continue and use a Mega Grenade to clear the cracked wall. There
are some chests in here, but they're blocked off. Walk forward and climb the
wall. Monsters block these chests, but they provide good EXP. Fight them all
and pick up the Heal Potions and Cure Potions. With those collected, return
to the previous platform. 

Since we can't head back south, continue by stepping onto the moving belt to
your east. Further east is a pulley system. Use the cart to get yourself to 
the bottom. Defeat the two Red Bones nearby and get the cracked door open. Go
through. The path on the left leads to nothing, so head right. Clear the 
monsters out of the way and move through the opening at the end. A Red Bone
guards a single chest. Inside is a Charm Claw; a very useful weapon that can
inflict multiple status ailments upon an enemy. 

Make your back to the previous area. Head south using the conveyor belt. You
will fall right onto a Zombie! Eww. Slay the Zombie and continue south and
west. Use a Mega Grenade to bomb the cracked wall. Head left and defeat the
various monsters in your way. Climb the wall at the end to the lower area.
Kill off the Red Bone and climb the other wall to the chest. It contains some
Explosives. Leave this cave. 

To your immediate right is a climb-able wall. Use the Charm Claw to get to the
top. Go west across the conveyor belt all the way back to the entrance area. 
Head south and use the pulley system to get to the bottom. Take the next
conveyor belt southbound. Get rid of the Zombie that you land upon and keep
going. Head east (across another conveyor belt) and climb up the wall. Take
the north conveyor belt to another Zombie. Keep going north until you reach
a belt leading east. Take it and fight the Red Bone. 

To the south is Jinn, a yellow freak blocking a door. 

      Boss Fight: Jinn ~
      =--------------=
           Begin the battle by clearing out the Red Bones that Jinn has next
           to him. Even though Jinn is fire-based, Blizzard doesn't seem to be
           super-effective against him. Jinn's Flame Pillar move is the one
           you will want to watch out for. 200+ damage will be dealt to both
           of your units. Both Benjamin and Reuben should have Life, so be
           sure to use it when the other falls. Use Mega Grenade or the Wizard
           spell, Thunder, to deal heavy damage. With the Charm Claw, you can
           poison Jinn. Simply keep your units alive with Cure and Life to win 
           out. 

Jinn will die without even uttering a word. Go through the door he was sitting
in front of. Outside, take the contents of the four chests and look across the
chasm. On the other side is Reuben's dad. Reuben will appear and chuck a Mega
Grenade to clear the boulder out of the way. He'll throw it and miss (???). 
The boulder still rolls away though. With the rock now clear, a whole new path
is clear. 

Now all you have to do is return to the entrance. Because all the conveyor
belts here are one-way, that might take some thought. Go north and defeat the
Red Bone blocking the other conveyor belt. Simply follow the belts until you
get back to the entrance. Remember that you have to climb the wall by the 
bombed door. Leave and head south, east, and south. You'll reach the Sealed
Temple that was previously inaccessible.

__________________________
                    ---=|      Sealed Temple       |=---
                         ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

Here is the strange man once more along with a strange tile and some chests. 
Talk to him and he'll ask for some coffee money...? Anyway! Take the Heal
Potions and Cure Potions from the chests and check out that weird tile. You
will be warped to the Wintry Temple. There are two chests here as well. Pick
up some more potions for the road. Step back onto the warp and return to the
Sealed Temple. Head off to Fireburg. 

You're probably itching for some healing. Sleep at the hotel if you need to.
Return to Reuben's house to find Arion. He must be psychic because he 
immediately tells you that the Crystal of Fire can be found in the Lava Dome.
Whatever. Leave Fireburg and head west and north. Another Battlefield awaits
your blade. 

     Battlefield Seventeen ~
     =-------------------=
          Monsters: Red Bone, Zombie, Ghost
          Prize: 1200 EXP
           ~ Red Bones and Zombies are pushovers as you probably already know.
             The only real danger with Zombies is the fact that they can
             regenerate themselves if you take too long. The Cure spell can
             deal heavy damage if you use it against them. Ghosts can be a 
             bit tough though. They might take multiple hits to take down.
             Also, Ghosts are capable of multiplying, which basically 
             introduces another Ghost into the battle. Luckily, Ghosts 
             sometimes have a tendency to "not do anything" so you shouldn't 
             have a problem.

Head past the Battlefield to reach the Volcano. After getting through this, we
can head over to the Lava Dome at last.

__________________________
                    ---=|          Volcano         |=---
                         ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

Northeast from the entrance is a staircase. Start off by climbing it to the
top. First, defeat the Were Wolf guarding the cave. Proceed through. You can't
see your position, but you should be able to tell where you are. Head a tiny
bit to the left and exit through the other opening. The chest contains the
White spell; a very powerful Wizard spell. 

Go back to the entrance area and defeat the Ghost to your left. You'll reach
another staircase. To the left of it are some monsters guarding a single chest.
Inside are some Cure Potions. Now, head up the steps and look to your right. 
A gap lies in-between you and the next ledge. Jump across it to the other 
side. A bunch of monsters will block your way forward. Clear them out and head
up the stairs to reach the next area of the Volcano. 

A thick shroud of gas prevents you from being able to see any nearby monsters.
In order to see through, you'll need the Mask, of which is hidden somewhere 
around. Walk up a little bit and turn left. Simply follow the path until you
hit an opening in the wall. Again, you can't see yourself. Head right to get
out. Steal some Heal Potions and keep going. Once at the next area, you have
two ways to go. Some Explosives are straight ahead. To get the Mask, head
left. 

Don't be surprised if you suddenly run into monsters. Walk up the stairs to
the next area. Amazing, the gas has suddenly disappeared! Defeat the monster
to your left and trot up the steps. Kill off the Were Wolf and snag the Mask
from the chest. Before you return to the previous area, defeat the Nitemare
to your left. The chest behind it contains some more Cure Potions. Now, 
backtrack to the first area with the gas. Return all the way to the entrance
of that room. 

This time, go straight ahead to a staircase. Defeat the Nitemare in front of 
it and proceed to the next area. Defeat another Nitemare and continue. Use
the opening and move eastward. Keep on heading east until you reach another
set of stairs. Climb it to the top and get rid of the Ghost that greets you.
You can choose to take the path on the right for some Cure Potions before
climbing the steps. There are a bunch of monsters on this ledge. Before 
continuing up the stairs to your left, you can beat up some more enemies for
some Heal Potions. 

You will reach the top of the volcano after climbing up the stairs. Heal up
before fighting Medusa!

     Boss Fight: Medusa ~
     =----------------=
          Begin by taking out the Were Wolves that join the fight. Benjamin
          should use White while Reuben just attacks with his Morning Star.
          Try to take them out before they manage to pull off a Quake or 
          something. White deals a lot of damage. Only a few castings are
          needed to put her down. Be sure to have Reuben heal when needed.
          Keep Benjamin alive while Reuben heals and attacks. Beware of her
          Screech Voice move; it's capable of confusing a unit. Stone Voice
          can petrify and Para-snake can paralyze. Ouch. 

Well, with her out of the way, you can descend the stairs to finally get out
of the Volcano. Now you can continue onward to the Lava Dome. However, you
might want to return to Fireburg for some healing. Buy any last-minute items
that you might need before venturing into the core of the cinder-cone.

__________________________
                    ---=|        Lava Dome         |=---
                         ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

Begin by heading east. Defeat the Hot Wings and descend the staircase that it 
was blocking. At the bottom, continue eastward and fight the Ninja (*ahem* a
PINK Ninja). Once more, head down the steps and go through the opening to your
west. Inside this cave, simply go right. Get rid of the various monsters and
continue until you are stopped by some lava. Jump across the steps. Demolish
the cracked rock a Mega Grenade and beat up the Medusa-wannabe. The chest she
was guarding contains the Life spell!

Return to the entrance of the cave and head north. Climb the wall and continue
northwest. A bunch of enemies here will make life much harder for you. At the
end of the northwest path are some Explosives -- 20 to be exact. Return to the
wall and move southwest. Clear the monsters out of the way and leave through 
this alternative exit. Three Refreshers can be found in the chest. With those
collected, simply climb down and drop off. 

Going east from here will lead you to the original cave entrance. Defeat the
Avizzards and drop down the wall it was blocking. You have two ways to go from
here. Let's head west. Defeat another Iflyte and climb the stairs leading UP.
Another pink Ninja awaits. Move west and ignore the next set of stairs. Keep
going in that direction and kill the next Ninja. Another cave entrance is just
ahead. Enter. 

Proceed north and do whatever you'd like with the Hot Wings. The next area is
absolutely infested with monsters. Fight them for the valuable EXP and pick up
some Refreshers, Heal Potions, and Cure Potions. Now, look to your left. In
the lava is a collection of platforms that can be jumped. Head north and jump
onto the first block. Head downward until you see the two boulders. Throw a 
Mega Grenade to blast them out of the way. Move over to the northwest corner 
and kill off another monster blocking the door. 

Ugh, another line of monsters. Keep going north until you reach two chests.
The one to the far northwest contains a Moon Helm. The other holds some Cure
Potions. Do not forget the former! With that, return to the previous room. 
Jump over the platforms and head southeast. Follow the path until you reach
an Avizzard in front of some stairs. Head down and descend the other staircase
to the next floor. Just keep going and you'll eventually find yourself back
outside. To your west is a monster blocking a strange tile. Step on it and
the door to the right will open. 

Okay, with the door open, we can now access the boss. Drop off the ledge and
kill off the Avizzard. Head down the steps that it was blocking. To your south
is the switch you just pressed. See the cave on your ledge? Enter it for some
items. The first chest has some Cure Potions. If you keep heading in deeper, 
you'll reach another opening. Go through to the next chamber. At the split,
head north. Upon reaching the end of this path, you'll be rewarded with some
Heal Potions and Cure Potions. Return to the fork. This time, take the left
branch. 

Keep heading north until you reach the steps leading up to the ledge. Walk up 
and go left and south. Jump the gap at the end and fight the Salamand. Jump
the next gap and kill off the Stheno to access the chest. Take the Heal 
Potions and return to the stairs. Go east and follow the path. Ignore the
first gap jump across the second. After getting rid a Adamant Turtle, you can
pick up some Heal Potions. Return to that other gap and jump across it.

Now that we're on the right track, continue northbound. Defeat the Salamand
that is sitting at the corner. Advance west and you will finally reach the 
door leading out of here. In the next room, there are two chests. Both are
haphazardly surrounded by monsters though. If you aren't at level 24 yet, I'd
suggest beating up monsters until you are. Both chests contain Cure Potions, 
so you're not missing out on anything if you don't open them. Anyway, keep 
going and enter the next room. 

Instead of climbing the wall, just climb the staircase to your left. Another
Avizzard will await you at the top. Enter the next cave. You will have to 
travel down some stairs before you even get anywhere. Defeat the Hot Wings
to your right and proceed down the steps. There are a bunch of chests in this
room. Likewise, there are also a bunch of monsters. Head south until you find
some steps. Defeat the Salamand and get ready to do a lot of jumping around. 

The first gap to your left will take you to a chest (Heal Potions). Return to
the other path. If you keep going, you'll come across two gaps. Jump across
the left one and open the chest for some Cure Potions. Now, hop across the gap 
on the right and beat up the monster. Step down to the lower area and go down. 
Clear out the Hot Wings. To the west are some Heal Potions. The right path 
will reveal some Cure Potions. Head back north and step up to the ledge with 
the Ninja on it. 

Defeat the Ninja and jump to the other ledge. Proceed and kill off the Ninja
guarding the chest containing Heal Potions. To continue, you can just walk
through the nearby doorway. However, if you want some more items, you can
explore the rest of this room. When you're done, exit through the said 
doorway. You will appear just before the big doors that you have opened 
before. Clear out the single Salamand up ahead. 

Yay, more jumping. First, hop to the right. At the fork, jump south. Defeat
the Stheno and open the chest for some (once again) Cure Potions. Jump all
the way back to the center platform. This time, go left. At the fork, head
north. Get rid of the Stheno and go west. The northwest platform has some
more Cure Potions for you. Head east and you'll finally reach the big man
himself. Meet the Dualhead Hydra. 

     Boss Fight: Dualhead Hydra ~
     =------------------------=
          The White spell will be your salvation in this battle. Although you
          obviously can't cast it forever, it still will deal a considerable 
          amount of damage to the Dualhead Hydra. Reuben is useful for healing,
          so have him use Life to replenish your party's HP. The Dualhead 
          Hydra is capable of quite a few different attacks. Para-Breath and
          Poison Breath will paralyze and poison, respectively. Stone Gas will
          petrify. Heal Potions will clear a unit of those annoying ailments.
          Fire Breath deals heavy damage as well. Although a Moon Helm can 
          help defend against Fire Breath, Reuben (without any fire protection)
          will surely be fried. It's not imperative that he survives, but he 
          really helps out with his Life spell. 

From the ashes of its corpse, the third crystal will materialize. Reuben will
congratulate you and mention Windia, the sector of the fourth crystal. A 
sudden earthquake will ravage the land and some lava will blast out of the
volcano. Pick up the Sun Coin before hopping out of here. 

Well, the land hasn't really changed. However, there are no more earthquakes
despite the fact that the volcano is still standing. Strange.

The recent eruption created a new path to another Battlefield and an 
alternative route to the northeast sector. Before you continue, tackle the
Battlefield. 

     Battlefield Eighteen ~
     =------------------=
          Monsters: Iflyte, Stheno
          Prize: 1068 EXP
           ~ Monsters here are basically the same ones that you have already

             trouble taking these down. If you want to clear them quickly,

             Wizard magic counter. This is a somewhat difficult Battlefield,

Head over to the Focus Tower. Be sure to take the entrance that puts you in
front of the four "special" doors.

                         ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

Now, with the Sun Coin, you can open the purple door. That man is waiting for
you past the door. Be on the lookout for Captain Mac's ship! Anyway, the exit
is past the staircase. However, if you want the Aero spell, descend the steps
into the Doom Castle. This castle, for some reason, is underground. Anyway, 
defeat the single monster and pick up your Aero spell. We'll access the rest
of this castle later. Return and leave the Focus Tower. 

                         __________________________
                    ---=|        Rope Bridge       |=---
                         ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

This bridge is in major need of repair as you can see. Begin by walking ahead
and a Mummy will materialize out of thin air. Reuben will step up to the plate
and take care of this monster. You can probably predict what will happen next.
Yep, the monster knocks him off the bridge. And of course, you're left to put
this Mummy in its place. It seems that Reuben is fine. He'll catch up later. 
Tristam will also appear and decides to join your party. NOOO! I want Reuben
back!!

You can climb down some of the vines to find cool stuff in chests. However,
there's really nothing you DESPERATELY need. Make it to the end of the bridge

                    ---=|       Alive Forest       |=---
                         ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

There are a few monsters here. For some Cure Potions, look to your north and
cut down some trees. Fight the two monsters and open the chest. Now, cut the
trees south of the group of trees in the shape of an arrow pointing left. 
Continue and fight the Mummy. Head down the steps and you'll reach a giant 
tree stump with a strange tile on it. Continue east from there to meet two
more monsters by a tree with a face on it. 

Talk to it and Tristam will recommend getting Kaeli here because she can 
obviously talk to trees... Head southeast from the talking tree to find 
another gigantic tree stump. South of it is a chest containing the Giant's
Axe; the most powerful axe in the game! Of course, monsters guard it. To find
Kaeli, you'll have to head over to Phoebe's house in Aquaria. Do just that.

Place underneath her house. Find the old man and talk to him. Tristam will
appear and gets sidetracked by Spencer's offer. Looks like he'll be leaving

Place and check on Kaeli. She'll join with awesome stats. 

Now it's time to return to the Alive Forest. Check on that big, talking tree
and he'll be like, "Yo, wassup." Then Kaeli will say some stuff. The big tree
will let you go through if you whack some monsters in him.

__________________________
                    ---=|        Giant Tree        |=---
                         ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

So you're inside a giant tree. Not exactly the most creative thing ever, but
I guess it'll do. 

Begin by heading right. Defeat the monsters blocking the path. The chest at 
the end contains some Cure Potions. Return to the entrance and head straight. 
At the fork, head right. Of course, some more enemies will try to block you. 
A Live Oak guards a chest full of Refreshers. Head back to the split and take
the left fork this time. 

Clear out the monsters and continue west until you hit the wall. There are two
chests above and below you. Steal the Cure Potions and Heal Potions and 
continue north. Follow the path east and climb the wall. Here's where it gets
fun. Take out your Dragon Claw and aim at the little stub to your south. Use
it and you'll be grappled to the other platform. Repeat this process with the
platform south of that one. Look to your west and use the Dragon Claw to get
to the following ledge. Keep doing this until you reach a door. Go right
through. 

Head east first. Kill off the Snipion and snag some Heal Potions from the
chest. From your current position, you should be able to see a special chest
to your southeast. How do we get there? You'll soon see. Keep going south and
defeat the next row of enemies. After finishing off the Mad Toad, go through
the doorway a tiny bit to the right. Whoa, mushroom paradise! This room is
also infested with Mad Toads. Apparently, frogs in this game love mushrooms
for some reason. 

Use the Giant's Axe and cut a path to the two chests. Defeat the Mad Toad and 
steal some Cure Potions and Explosives. Backtrack a little bit and slice a 
path to the south end of the room. This next part will be sure to take a long
time. Defeat each and every Mad Toad while you progress around the room. Use
Blizzard as they're weak against water (for some reason). Eventually, you'll 
reach the exit door. The last monster that you'll fight before the chest is a 
Snipion. Finally, you can open it for the well-deserved Meteor spell. 

Return to the entrance of this floor. Head west this time and follow that 
path. You can use the Dragon Claw to get across the gap in the floor. Kill off
the Live Oak and continue onwards. If you go all the way east, you can pick up
some more Cure Potions. Climb the wall nearby and walk west. Use the Dragon
Claw to reach the door. Alternatively, you could have climbed the other wall,
but you would have never gotten to Cure Potions. Clear the Mad Frog out of the
way. The door appears to be closed. Simply poke it with a sword to force it
open. 

Before climbing down, take some Heal Potions from the chest. Climb down and
defeat the two monsters on your left. Open the two chests for some more Cure
Potions and Heal Potions (I'm getting tired of saying those words). Climb
back up to the starting position and get rid of the Leech on the left. Grapple
to the platform on your left. Continue south until you meet some more Leeches.
Kill 'em all. 

Keep going until you reach a door. Like before, just poke it with a sword to
force it open. Yes, it's another mushroom room. The Leeches hanging around 
are sure to give you a headache. Begin by heading west. Remember that Leeches
are weak against axe attacks. Make your way to the northwest corner. Once
there, climb the wall and drop down to the lower area. Fight the two Leeches
and proceed south. Simply go through the door to get out of that hellhole.

Back out here, go southwest to a vine. Climb it down and drop off. Down here,
walk north a bit to find another closed door. You know the drill. Stab it and
head through. On this floor, you will find yourself on a ledge. A Mad Toad
will block a wall that you can climb. Bring it down and climb the following
wall. This next part is a bit tough. You'll have to drop off by releasing the
A Button. When you hit the other part, hit the A Button so that you latch on.
Repeat this process until you reach another door. Stab it and proceed. 

We're almost done, luckily. Head south at first and defeat the various monsters
and such. You will come to three doors. You can enter either the door in
the middle or the one on the left. There are various items scattered in the
following mushroom room. If you want them, then seek them out. Hack your way
through the mushrooms while following the path. You should not get too much
interference from the Oozes. Climb the wall and exit through the nearby 
opening. 

Immediately kill off the nearby Leech. Advance northward while taking care of
more monsters. You will have to walk clockwise around this platform to 
actually get anywhere. You should reach a climb-able wall. You can use the
Dragon Claw to grapple on the stub to the south. Two chests can be found on
that platform. If you want Explosives or some more Cure Potions, open those
chests. Finally, climb the wall and stab the door to force it open. Proceed. 

Ah crap, more monsters. To your immediate south are some chests containing
Cure Potions and Heal Potions. If you'd prefer to go out of your way for some
more chests, head over to the northwest corner for some Explosives and more
Heal Potions. Before you climb the wall to the boss (at the north end of the
room), remember to heal up. 

     Boss Fight: Gidrah ~
     =----------------=
          Get rid of the two Skuldiers by using Aero. Once they are cleared
          out, have Benjamin use Meteor or White while Kaeli continues to
          blast Gidrah with Aero. Gidrah can paralyze and petrify your team,
          so watch out for those. Remember to use Heal in order to clear
          status ailments. If both units are petrified, then you lose. Make
          sure that doesn't happen. 

Walk up to the final door and examine it. It will offer to carry you to 
Windia. Enjoy the "ride" on the tree's branch as he transports you off. Use 
Exit to get out of there and continue. Next stop; the Kaidge Temple.

                         ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

Climb up the wall and meet the strange man once more. He'll mention Captain
Mac again and fly off. Proceed deeper into the cave if you need some Cure
Potions. If not, just skedaddle out of there. Up ahead are two more

     Battlefield Nineteen ~

          Prize: 2700 EXP

Just ahead of these two Battlefields is Windia, capital of the southeast. 
Let's check it out, yo.
