----- 10.0 Magic List -------------------------------------------------------
-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-=-


----Here is a list of all the magic in this game.----

(From PB8J's guide) Spells are different in Mystic Quest.  Rather than the
typical MP system, all  spells are considered to be of the same value of
usages.  For instance, if it says 11 under the White menu, that means that you
can use Exit 11 times, or you could use Cure 5 times and Exit 3 times and Heal
3 times.  All spells within a certain type of magic will always be equal. 
However, different types of magic have different amounts of uses.  Wizard magic
will always have the least amount of maximum uses because it features the most
powerful of all magics!


===================================WHITE MAGIC==================================

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEAT THE DARK KING EASILY!
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Use Cure magic on the Dark King to knock him out in 2 or 3 rounds.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
99 FOR EACH SPELL
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
After you beat the whole game, save right before you defeat the Dark King. Now
go to fight until you get to level 41. You should have around 42 White Spells,
21 Black Spells, and 1O Wizard Spells. Now fight until you get around 1O,OOO,OO
Extra Points. Your spells should have increased by 2 or 3! Do this until you
have 99 in all three types of Spells.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
BEAT SKULLRUS REX EASILY
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The first part of Doom Castle is guarded by another version of Flamerous Rex
called Skullrus Rex.Ê Most people would sigh and use all the magic in their
inventory.Ê Instead, just equip the hero with the Dragon Claw and scratch him
once and he goes down.Ê His ninja flunkies shouldn't be too much trouble after
that.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DEFEAT MINOTAUR ZOMBIE EASILY
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
When you first start a game, you have to get Kaeli and go to the Level Forest
to defeat the monster that poisened the trees. His name is Minotaur and is
really easy to defeat. When he attacks Kaeli, you have to fight him. To kill
him instantly, have Kaeli use the Life Spell on him and he's automatically
defeated!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DOUBLE LEVEL UP
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
When you fight in a battle field, fight the first nine battles and leave one.
Go somewhere besides a battle field (for instance, the Bone Dungeon) and get to
where your exp. points are very, very low.ÊAbout 1-100. Go to a battle field
where you don't win anything and defeat the last battle.Ê You'll get two level
ups instead of one.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
FULL HEAL
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Using the Cure spell 4-5 times to heal yourself and quaffing tons of cure
potions can be very annoying. To get a full heal, just use the Life spell. This
works IN and OUT of battle, so when you find a boss that has a special attack
that can mutilate your party in a few hits, use a Life spell to pump hp's back
up. :)

section: GET PHOEBE TO JOIN WITH 680 HIT POINTS
text:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
GET PHOEBE TO JOIN WITH 680 HIT POINTS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
When Phobe joins press A 3 times to get her to join as a 680 hp character. She
will be a powerful ally for a long time if you take care of her.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
GET THE DRAGON CLAW SOONER
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Normally you're not expected to have the amount of money Tristan wants for the
dragon claw when he gets it and offers to sell it. If you want to spend time
trying to get $9000, though, he'll give it to you. Unfortunately this can take
about as long as it would for you to normally get the dragon claw, depending
how frivolous you are in spending your money.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
INFINITE POTIONS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
At the beginning of the game, at the first forest, there is a treasure box
carrying potions. Take the potions and leave the forest. Now go back to the
forest and the treasure box will be full of potions again! Repeat this process
until you have as many potions as you want.
NOTE: You can do this in any town, forest, dungeon, etc. that has a treasure
box with any kind of healing item in it.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SUPER HEAL SPELL
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Once you get your Heal Spell,( Falls Basin ) you can really hurt an enemy. If
you use your Heal Spell on an enemy, it could put them to sleep, paralyze them,
poisen them, confuse them, and petrify them!! It works well against those enemys
that are hard to kill!!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ULTIMATE SPELLS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The Exit and Life Spells are very deadly. Most people think that the Exit Spell
will stop the battle you are currently in, and most people think that the Life
Spell will bring an enemy back to Life you have defeated! Well, the Life Spell
kills almost everybody unless they are strong against fatal attacks. The Exit
Spell kills everybody except the bosses. Have fun liquidating your enemys!!! 


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
USING BATTLEFIELDS WISELY
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In the game, go to a battlefield and fight a couple times. Then leave for
something else. When you get to a part of the game where you need more power,
go back to the battlefields and clear it out. Then, when you come back you
won't have to go through everything all over again!

This is another one of those games that has been considered a flop.  It really 
wasn't a flop, it was just the first RPG Squaresoft made for the SNES.  It may 
be a bit primative compared to today's standards, but certainly not a flop.  
This is a beginner's RPG, and should be treated a such.  It may be for 
beginners, but veteran RPG players can find some enjoyment in it.  I have 
played Square games for about 7 years now, and I still liked this game.  So, 
with that said, let's get to the walkthrough.

2) Characters:
[NOTE: In ALL of my Walkthroughs, the hero is referred to as Jason (Named 
after my husband.)  I got a semi nasty E-Mail about not naming the hero in one 
of my Walkthroughs correctly.  But I assure you, my readers, that I do know 
the real names of the hero in every game I have written about.  Thank you and 
enjoy!]

*Hero (Refered to from now on as Jason)- When you first meet Jason, he is 
climbing the Hill of Destiny (well, I guess when your village is destroyed, 
you have nothing better to do...).  Jason meets a Owl Like creature that 
informs him that he is the Knight of the ancient Prophecy (you know, you'll 
save the world, bring peace, all that...).  The Prophecy states that four 
monsters have locked the four doors (wow, four monsters- four doors!) of the 
Focus Tower and fled with the four keys.  You know what you have to do, save 
the world!  What else is new?
*Kaeli- This is the first character that joins your party (Not sure you can 
really call it a party, there are only two of you at any given time).  Kaeli 
has the ability to talk to trees, a trait that comes in handy both early on in 
the game and again later on in the game.  She hails from Foresta and when she 
joins you for the first time she has 120 Hit Points, attacks with an axe, and 
knows the spell of Life.  After the fight with Minotaur in the Level Forest, 
she leaves the group (she is poisoned in the attack) and gives you her axe!  
Kaeli will join you again later on in the game, when Phoebe blows up Spencer's 
Place.  When she rejoins you she is Level 31 and has 1280 Hit Points.
*Tristam- This character joins you in the Sand Temple.  Tristam is a treasure 
hunter (Hmmm....  Or is he a Thief????? Heeee)  and forces you to accompany 
him to the Bone Dungeon.  If he gets the treasure he seeks, he will give you 
the Elixir which you need to heal Kaeli from the fight with Minotaur.  Tristam 
takes his leave of you shortly after you fight Flamerus Rex.  He is good to 
his word, he gets his treasure, you get the Elixir.  Also while you are in the 
Bone Dungeon with Tristam, he teaches you to use Bombs, and will sell you 50 
explosives for 30 GP.  Tristam gives you some useful things: He gives you the 
Multi Key when you get to Fireburg, and the Dragon Claw later on in Spencer's 
Place.  Tristam joins you again on the Rope Bridge after Reuben falls.  
Tristam is now Level 23 and has 1120 Hit Points.
*Phoebe- You first meet Phoebe un the Libra Temple.  She originally hails from 
Aquaria.  She attacks with a Cat Claw at first, but once you get in the Wintry 
Cave, she gives it to you and starts to use the Bow of Grace.  She also 
teaches you to use Jumbo Bombs in the Falls Basin.  She leaves you sometime 
soon after the Ice Pyramid.  She joins you again in Windia after completing 
Mac's Ship.  She is then Level 34 and has 1480 Hit Points, and now knows the 
Spells of Cure, Heal, Life, Aero, Fire, Thunder, and White!  She will stay 
with you for the remainder of the game.
*Reuben- You meet Reuben in Fireburg where he joins you for the first time.  
He is Level 23 and has 1040 Hit Points.   He leaves you when he falls off the 
Rope Bridge.  He will join you again in Windia after the defeat of Pazuzu.  He 
will then be leve 31 and have 1320 Hit Points.  He knows the Spells of Life 
and White on your second meeting.
*Arion- He is Reuben's father.  You rescue him by completing the Mine quest 
and moving a large rock with Mega Grenades.  You learn to use Mega Grenades 
from the man in the locked home in Fireburg.
*Spencer- Spencer is Phoebe's grandfather.  He helps out with information a 
few times in the game.  His Place is where you find the Mobius Crest late in 
the game.
*Captain Mac- Mac is Kaeli's father.  His ship was caught on a ledge when 
water drained from a lake.  You rescue him and his ship late in the game and 
reunite Kaeli and her father.  He lets you take his ship in the ending 
sequences.
*Otto- You meet Otto in Windia.  He bulids you a Rainbow Road to get to 
Pazuzu's Tower so you can rescue his daughter Norma.  And another Rainbow Road 
to get back into Spencer's Place toward the end of the game.
*Norma- Otto's daughter.  You rescue her from Pazuzu's Tower later in the 
game.

12) Monster Class List
Every monster in Final Fantasy: Mystic Quest belongs to a specific class.  Any 
monster in a similar class will be weak against the same things, and usually 
attack you with the same things.
Class 1: Hooded Men
-Brownie
-MintMint
-Red Cap
They attack with: Punch, Kick, Stare, and Hypno-Sleep.
I have yet to find a weakness for these types of monsters.
Class 2: Slime Bodied
-Jelly
-Ooze
-Slime
They attack with: Dissolve, Hydro-Acid, and Stab.
This type of monster is weak against bombs.
Class 3: Turtles
-Adamant Turtle
-Land Turtle
They attack with: Blinder, Para-Claw, Body Slam, Rapier, and Wraparound.
This type of monster is weak against Axe attacks.
Class 4: Frogs 
-Giant Toad
-Mad Toad
-Poison Toad
They attack with: Poison Fluid, Body Odor, Whip Tongue, Stone Gaze, 
Electrapulse, and Poison-Touch.
This type of monster is weak against Blizzard.
Class 5: Worms
-Land Worm
-Leech
-Sand Worm
They attack with: Quake, Scrunch, and Quicksand.
This type of monster is weak against an Axe attack.
Class 6: Trees
-Live Oak
-Mad Plant
-Plant Man
They attack with: Corrode Gas, Full Nelson, Branch, and Bad Breath.
Class 7: Lizards
- Basilisk
-Flazzard
-Salamand
They attack with: Fang, Claw, Thunder, and Poison Breath.
They are weak against Blizzard.
Class 8: Birds
-Garuda
-Hot Wings
-*Pazuzu
-Roc
-Sparna
-Stoney Roost
-*Zuh
They attack with: Muffle, Iron Nail, Typhoon, Blinder, Flame Sweep, Dive, 
Windstorm, Hurricane, Psychshield, Stone, Beak, Sky Attack, Beak, Tornado, 
Petri-Touch, Coldness, and Doom Dance.
They are weak against a shoot attack (arrows or stars) and the Spell Aero.
Class 9: Man/Horse
-Centaur
-Nitemare

I have yet to find a weakness for these types of monsters.

17) Odds And Ends
*There is a free bed in Foresta in the tree stump house on your right at the 
bottom. Once inside it is the left bed.
*There is a very easy way to kill the Dark King (the end boss).  Just have 
Jason cast Cure on him.  But don't have your companion do the same.  Your 
companion will only undo the damage done by the hero.  But, now real 
adventurers will have no need for this, right?
*One tip, if you get to a dead end (well, one blocked by a chest) just jump 
over the obstacle.
*There are certain spells later in the game that monsters hit you with that 
can cause instant death if they connect.  These spells are: Corrode Gas, Doom 
Dance,  and Doom Powder.
*All Inns cost the same price to stay: 95 GP.
*After clearing Mac's Ship, and preparing to fight through the Doom Castle, in 
the lower levels of Mac's Ship, you can purchase Seeds and Cure Potions!  
Seeds Cost 50 GP for 1 and Cure Potions cost 25 for 1.

                                ITEMS

Name: Cure Potion
Effect: Restores HP
Location: Can be found just about anywhere and bought at Aquaria Inn,
Fireburg Inn, and Windia Inn. To be cheap, you can go in and out of
Foresta picking up the Cure Potions at Kaeli's house.

Name: Heal Potion
Effect: Cures abnormal status
Location: These can be found just about anywhere.  If you want to be
cheap you can go in and out of the Level Forest getting these.

Name: Refresher
Effect: Restores stat losses in battle
Location: These can be found in a couple places.  If you really need
some you can go in and out of Aquaria or Fireburg, they both contain
them.  In Aquaria there are in a house in the back and in Fireburg
they are at Rueben's House.

Name: Seeds
Effect: Restores all magic to max amount
Location: The best place to get these is to buy them at Fireburg
Inn.  I suggest buying alot because these are the best items in the
game (IMO).

Name: Captain Cap
Effect: Given to Captain Mac
Location: After you bomb Spencer's Place, go to Otto's house and talk
to Kaeli.

Name: Elixer
Effect: Saves Kaeli's Life
Location: Recieved from Tristam after beating Flamerus Rex in the
Bone Dungeon.

Name: Thunder Rock
Effect: Give to Otto at Windia
Location: Go to Rueben's House at Fireburg.  When you enter there
should be a person in a bed.  He will give you the Rock.  This event
will only happen once you beat Pazuzu.

Name: Tree Wither
Effect: Gets Kaeli to join your party
Location: Push the boulder blocking the old man's way at Level
Forest.


Name: Wakewater
Effect: Use on plant in the middle of Aquaria
Location: Enter the Libra Temple and transport on the crest sign to
the Life Temple. Just talk to the cloaked man to receive the item.

Name: Multi-Key
Effect: Opens a door in Fireburg
Location: After you get Reuben in your party, try to open the
building in the middle of the town. After you try to do that, go back
to Rueben's house and talk to Tristam.  He will give you this key.

Name: Venus Key
Effect: Opens a chest in Focus Tower
Location: Enter Aquaria and go in the water to go under the building
in the bottom left hand corner.  When you enter the building you will
be in Spencer's Place.  There is only one way you can go, so just
follow the path to reach Spencer.  When you talk to him he will hand
over the key.

Name: Magic Mirror
Effect: Enemies at Ice Pyramid will now be revealed
Location: At the Ice Pyramid, first use the sword against the moving
statue which will open a door.  Go through the door and immediately
walk right.  Now walk all the way down and then all the way right.
Go straight up and you should be near a fight with a gray desert hag.
After that fight go right to get in a fight with a Lamia and after
you defeat her just go right and open the chest.

Name: Mask
Effect: Enemies at Volcano will now be revealed
Location: At the Volcano entrance, move to the left defeat a Ghost
and go up the stairs.  Jump across the ledge and fight the Red Bone.
Keep fighting all the enemies in the path to go up to the next level.
Go to the left and down the steps.  Keep following the path until you
reach a hole in the wall.  Follow the invisible path to be let out
near a brown chest with heal potions.  Keep following the path to the
right and go up to the next level.  After you go up the stairs go to
the left and follow the path to go up another flight of stairs.  Now,
beat the ghost to your immediate left and then the wolf behind him.
After you beat the wolf, you can now get the Mask.

Name: Libra Crest
Effect: Activates Libra warp pads
Location: Received after beating Squidite at the Wintry Cave

Name: Gemini Crest
Effect: Activates Gemini warp pads
Location: From Focus Tower to Fireburg, there are 3 battlefields in a
row.  The middle battlefield contains the crest.

Name: Mobius Crest
Effect: Activates Mobius warp pads
Location: After Reuben bombs Spencer's Place to free the ship, you
can get this crest.  First you must go to the right and up to reach
somewhere where you can drop in the water.  Once you are in the
water, just go all the way left and go up.  You will find another
place where you can climb up.  Go all the way north on this platform
and bomb the door so you can get through.  Now go back to the
enterance and go left this time. Jump over the square and go north
through the cave just left of the crest marking.  Go through the
crest that looks like a headband and you can now reach the chest with
the mobius crest.

Location: Received after beating Flamerus Rex at the Bone Dungeon

Name: Sky Coin

                                SPELLS

a) White Spells

Spell: Cure
Effect: Restores HP to one or all targets
Location: Found at Foresta in the top right tree around the back 
entrance.

Spell: Exit
Effect: Brings you to the world map if used outside of battle.  The 
spell can also be used as an offensive spell.  It warps an enemy out of 
the battlefield (Credit to xpranger@hotmail.com).

Location: Go to the battlefield north of Libra Temple. Clear out the 
battlefield to win the prize.

Spell: Heal
Effect: Cures any abnormal statuses
Location: The spell is next to the boss, Snow Crab, at Falls Basin.

Spell: Life
Effect: Restores all HP and abnormal status effects or revives one 
character to full HP
Location: At the Lava Dome, go to the right and defeat the monster.
After you win, go down to the next platform and defeat the Ninja.
Keep going down the stairs to enter a cave.  Head to the right and 
follow the path to another monster which is guarding the spell.  This 
spell can also kill any non-zombie enemies (Credit to DragonHealer)

b) Black Spells

Spell: Aero
Effect: A wind attack that damages one or all targets
Location: Go through the purple door in the Focus Tower and go down
the first set of stairs to enter Doom Castle. Defeat the one enemy in
your way for the chest.

Spell: Blizzard
Effect: An ice attack that damages one or all targets
Location: Open the door in the focus tower with the Venus Key and
find the Blizzard spell on the left side of the room at the Focus 
Tower.

Spell: Fire
Effect: A fire attack that damages one or all targets
Location: Enter the focus tower, and when you see a one-wall block of
wall go through it and up the stairs.  Open the orange door and go up
until you can go up some stairs.  Now go south until you reach the
chest.

Spell: Quake
Effect: An earth attack that damages all targets
Location: At Bone Dungeon, later in the stage you will be traveling
through a set of ribs once you enter the room.  Midway through the
structure there is a little break to the left in the wall where you
can walk through the bones.  Follow the path and defeat the monsters
along the way to reach the chest.

c) Wizard Spells

Spell: Flare
Effect: Strong fire attack that damages all targets
Location: It is on the 5th floor of Pazuzu's Tower.  You have to come
down from the stairs on the 6th floor to reach it.

Spell: Meteor
Effect: Strong earth attack that damages all targets
Location: At the Giant Tree, go to the second floor.  Once you reach
this floor go down 4 steps then all the way right then all the way
down.  Keep going right and down to reach the door.  When you enter
go up 2 and left 1 and cut down the mushroom in front of you with
your axe.  Make sure you go down the small path on the bottom of your
screen.  Follow this path around and defeat the monsters on the path
to reach the chest.

Spell: Thunder
Effect: Strong electric attack that damages one or all targets
Location: Go to the second battlefield west of Fireburg.  Clear out
the battlefield to win the prize.

Spell: White
Effect: Strong attack that damages one or all targets
Location: Enter the Volcano and go up the stairs to the right.  At
the top, fight the wolf and go through the door.  Walk to the left
and when you come out the other door you are at the chest with the

Name: Noble Armor
Defense: 12
Protection: Water, Poison
Location: At Ice Pyramid.

Name: Gaia's Armor
Defense: 15
Protection: Water, Wind, Sleep, Poison
Location: At Mac's Ship.

c) Shields

Name: Steel Shield
Defense: 5
Protection: Nothing
Location: After buying the bombs from Tristam at Bone Dungeon, you
can backtrack to the 2nd room of the dungeon and bomb the wall there
for this shield.

Name: Venus Shield
Defense: 10
Protection: Paralyze
Location: Open a locked door in the focus tower with the Venus Key.

Name: Aegis Shield
Defense: 14
Protection: Paralyze, Stone
Location: At Doom Castle, go all the way west then up from the
enterance.  Once you get to the top go all the way to the right to
the last set of stairs going down to the sand pit.  Go down these
stairs and travel down the sand until you reach some fossils.  Bomb
the fossils and defeat the monster guarding the chest.

d) Accessory

Name: Charm
Defense: 1
Protection: Nothing
Location: Head to the battlefield left of Bone Dungeon.  Clear out
the battlefield to win this prize.

Name: Magic Ring
Defense: 3
Protection: Silence
Location: Head to the battlefield that is directly left of Aquaria.
Clear out the battlefield to win this prize.

Name: Cupid Locket
Defense: 6
Protection: Silence, Blind, Confusion
Location: At Windia, go to the house on your immediate left and talk
to the girl and buy it from her.

***********************************************************************
                               WEAPONS

Each weapon, except bombs, raises in attack power when you increase a
level. I think it is around 2.5 more attack per level.  All attack
values are level 1 based. Bombs are generally the strongest weapon
when you initially get them, but by the time you reach level 32 they
will be your weakest.

a) Swords

Name: Steel Sword
Attack: 12
Status effects: Nothing
Location: Initial Weapon

Name: Knight Sword
Attack: 54
Status effects: Nothing
Location: At the Ice Pyramid, a while through the dungeon you will
have to bomb a little breakable section on the map.  When you fall
through this hole you will be surrounded by chests, one of which is
the sword.

Name: Excalibur
Attack: 134
Status effects: Nothing
Location: It is at Pazuzu's Tower on the 3rd or 4th floor.  You first
have to climb up the tower and then start making your way down
another path to be able to reach this chest.

b) Axe

Name: Axe
Attack: 16
Status effects: Nothing
Location: Kaeli gives it to you.

Name: Battle Axe
Attack: 69
Status effects: Nothing
Location: A women sells it in Fireburg.  Her house is in the south
part of the town.

Name: Giant's Axe
Attack: 102
Status effects: Nothing
Location: In the Alive Forest where the giant tree is, head left and
cut down the trees while heading south.  Once you reach another big
tree you should see a chest.  Make your way to it and get the axe.

c) Claw

Name: Cat Claw
Attack: 9
Status effects: Poison, Paralyze
Location: Phoebe gives it to you when you slip and fall in the Wintry
Cave.

Name: Charm Claw
Attack: 44
Status effects: Poison, Paralyze, Sleep, Confusion, Blind
Location: When you enter the mine take the belt going up.  Fight the
skeleton at the top and then go to the right and take another belt.
Once you get off the belt you should see a bucket you can enter to go
down.  To your left you should see some skeletons blocking an
entrance which you will want access too. Take the right path inside
this cave to reach the chest.

Name: Dragon Claw
Attack: 87
Status effects: Poison, Paralyze, Sleep, Confusion, Blind, Stone,
Silence
Location: Once you finish going through the Alive Forest, go back to
Aquaria.  Go back into Spencer's Place and follow the path all the
way down to the 2nd screen.  Tristam will give you the claw when you
talk to the man on this screen.

d) Bomb (Can be bought at Aquaria Inn or found in various places.  An
easy way to get them from the only brown chest at Libra Temple.)

Name: Bomb
Attack: 63
Status effects: Nothing
Location: Buy them from Tristam when you enter Bone Dungeon. Say no
the first time if you want to buy them for a cheaper price.

Name: Jumbo Bomb
Attack: 112
Status effects: Nothing
Location: Phoebe will give them to you when you beat the Snow Crab at
Falls Basin.

Name: Mega Grenade
Attack: 162
Status effects: Nothing
Location: After you get the multi-key, go in the building in the
middle of Fireburg.  Talk to the guy to receive the bombs.
